tieu_de: THE WEDDING OF the Buddha's disciple
tom_tat: Ask: Young Catholics can have their wedding at church, which they do very solemnly and grandly. Does Buddhism oppose male-female marriage? Never heard of Buddha temple holding weddings...
noi_dung:
Ask: Young Catholics can have their wedding at church, which they do very solemnly and grandly. Does Buddhism oppose male-female marriage? Never heard of Buddha temple holding weddings for its disciples.
Answer: In Notes on modern cause and effect, Venerable Dieu Phap answered this question. Buddhism believes that marriage between a man and a woman is a heavenly event (it is natural and there is nothing wrong), and Buddhist disciples are no exception. I just hope that after getting married, Buddha disciples can build a Buddhist family and become an example of Buddhist practice.
The way to be a husband is to love your wife like a sister, never leave her, take care of family karma, not be afraid of hardship, and be an example for your children.
A wife must respect her husband, love her children, take care of her parents-in-law, be frugal in taking care of the family, live according to her ability, share joys and humiliations, and never complain.
Venerable Master Hsuan Hua at the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas in the US once presided over the wedding of disciples Qua Thi and Qua Kim at Truong De Thanh Tu Pagoda in 1994. Below is the full text of the Venerable's speech at that wedding for everyone to refer to:
In the I Ching it says: "One yin and one yang is the path, the difference between yin and yang is the pole." Yin and Yang are in harmony, then heaven and earth
Newly green, new things grow; If yin and yang are not in harmony, heaven and earth will not be green, and all living things will not grow. Therefore, from these sutra texts, the path of a gentleman begins with husband and wife. Heaven is a great heaven, people are small heavens, so every human gesture and action should follow heaven and earth.
Talking about yin and yang: South belongs to Qian, Qian belongs to Yang; Women belong to Kun, Kun belongs to yin. Therefore, Qiankun is the beginning of the hexagram, the hexagram Qian is three consecutive lines; The Khone hexagram has six broken lines, which is male and female. The male counterpart is the Qian hexagram, the female counterpart is the Kun hexagram, that is the Qian Kun hexagram.
After marriage, the Qian hexagram turns into "lying the center of damage", the Kun hexagram turns into "mosaic loyal contentment", combined with each other to become Kham Ly. Ly is "lying in the middle of damage", Kham is "mosaic in the middle of completeness". The morality of a gentleman begins with husband and wife, men and women living together is human morality, this reason needs to follow heaven and earth. To follow heaven and earth is to be in harmony and joy. Heaven and earth cannot live a day without harmony, and human hearts cannot live without joy for an hour. You look, when the sky is clear and cloudy, the plants are lush and the birds and animals are happy; But if the rain is angry and the wind is angry, the birds and animals will be sad as if they want to cry.
From the above, we need to follow heaven and earth, heaven and earth need peace every day, people's hearts need joy every minute and every second. Therefore, after getting married, we must live until we are gray, must respect each other, we should not be like today's couples, if we get married and do not get along, it will cause chaos in the family. This is because we do not know how to be husband and wife, causing the house to not be like a house, the country to be not like a country, people not to be like people, and society to no longer be in order.
Therefore, after getting married, the two of you must truly love each other, should not follow other couples, must always respect each other, love and respect each other.
Loving and respecting each other means not seeing imperfections. Therefore, we must respect each other, the ancients said: "Respect for each other is like respect" means that husband and wife must always treat each other like guests.
“Can you two do that?” (Both responded): “Yes!”
"We must always respect each other as guests. We must not only rely on appearances without feelings in our hearts. We must be sincere, is that okay?" (Both responded): “Yes!”
“So you two have wedding rings, let's exchange wedding rings!”
(The officiant: They exchange beads!)
Venerable: “Exchanging beads! Then chant Buddha! You two, please have many children, so they can leave the home life to become monks!” (Everyone laughs loudly)
(The monk smiled and said): “The two of you exchange beads, under the word "mind" there is the word "mind", you must use your heart, exchange, and treat each other with sincerity! OK? Please do well yourself!”
Adultery: In terms of cause and effect, adultery is the heaviest crime and receives the heaviest punishment. If a couple divorces and then remarries, based on the law of cause and effect, when they die, their bodies are cut into two parts. Because when alive, there is a relationship between both parties, so when karma appears, a saw appears, cutting from head to toe and splitting in two. No matter how many times you give birth to adultery, after death it will be cut off that many times. When you are born and get married a hundred times, when you die, it will be cut off a hundred times, until each person divides it little by little. A woman marries 100 men, she will be sawed into 100 pieces. The man married 100
women, they were also sawed into hundreds of pieces. 100 women, each with a portion, were divided into tattered pieces. So what good is separation or divorce?
What happens when cut into pieces? The spiritual nature will be scattered, it will be very difficult for the spiritual nature to gather together again, this opportunity is not easy to come by. If we no longer have this opportunity, our spiritual nature will forever be incomplete and humans will become a heartless plant. Because human nature is divided to the point where it is not enough to function as a living being; Even if it became a living being, it would take the form of a swarm of eighty-four thousand mosquitoes or something like that. These mosquitoes will become mosquitoes again but they will not be able to enlightenment and find their true nature. They will continuously be born and die within samsara.
That's why there is a saying, "Once you lose your human body, it will be difficult to get it back in ten lifetimes." Once our human body is lost, even if we go through millions of subsequent lives, it will not be easy to regain our human body.

tieu_de: bowing to the Buddha CAN CURE EVERY DISEASE
tom_tat: Ask: Health Newspaper reported that "bowing your head and bending your back" can also cure illness. Chinese medicine bone and joint specialist, Director of Quang Minh Bone and Joint Hospital - Beijing said: "Bow your head and bend your back" is a basic movement of the human spine...
noi_dung:
Ask: Health Newspaper reported that "bowing your head and bending your back" can also cure illness. Chinese medicine bone and joint specialist, Director of Quang Minh Bone and Joint Hospital - Beijing said: "Bow your head and bend your back" is a basic movement of the human spine, can maintain 'spinal qi', and is a simple way to prevent and treat neck pain and back pain. I am sick, my neck has been sore for a long time, many treatments have not been effective, according to the method published in the newspaper, every day I bow my head 100 times, after 20 times I bend my head, rest once and continue, a month later I am cured. I don't abstain from eating salty foods, nor do I repentance, what is the reason for this?
Answer: The disease is usually caused by three causes: The first is due to long-term poor work or living habits, causing the body to work hard and get sick or weaken the body with aging; The second is due to karma from killing; Third is the disease brought from the karma of the previous life.
For example, people who often write for long periods of time and use too much force when writing will have painful joints in their thumb and index finger. If they do not change their habits over time, they will become inflamed, swollen and painful. Or like an accountant, if you work with your head bowed for long periods of time, your neck will easily have problems. People who like to eat and drink excessively will gradually have problems with their stomach and spleen, etc. Diseases caused by hard work and bad habits can also be called cause and effect diseases - hard work and bad habits are the cause, problems are the result. Change and adjust the Cause, the disease will be cured. Changing and adjusting yourself is about recognizing mistakes and
Isn't amendment also a form of "repentance"? You definitely work with your head down for a long time, right?
"Yes, I work a lot with computers."
"Bow down" is a change and adjustment movement, so people who work in one position for a long time need to exercise appropriately during breaks. In fact, the best method to cure this disease is to bow your head and bow to the Buddha, which is both respect for the Buddha and the best whole-body exercise. When bowing to the Buddha according to the Buddhist method, every joint in the body moves. Every day bowing to the Buddha 100 times in front of the Buddha, the effect will definitely be superior to normal bowing. If you can try abstaining from salty foods, diseases caused by the following two causes will also improve or be completely cured.
If you cannot bow 100 times at a time, you can start from a little to a lot, gradually increasing. I saw someone bowing to the Buddha
1,000 to 2,000 times per day. They bowed until their whole bodies were cured and their faces were rosy and radiant. I have also seen a laywoman over 60 years old bowing 300 times in the great ceremony (Tibetan's full body bowing style) every day, her spirit and health were like that of a young person.

tieu_de: THE UNBORN CHILD LOVES LISTENING TO THE Ksitigarbha Sutra
tom_tat: A neighbor told me that her daughter was 8 months pregnant and had very strong pregnancy reactions. In recent months, the fetus often kicked and kicked in her stomach, causing her daughter a lot of pain. Some people...
noi_dung:
A neighbor told me that her daughter was 8 months pregnant and had very strong pregnancy reactions. In recent months, the fetus often kicked and kicked in her stomach, causing her daughter a lot of pain. Someone advised her to recite Buddha's name to relieve pain. Her daughter also believed it, but because her husband's family is Muslim, she did not dare to recite it.
I told her that Buddhism, Christianity, Christianity, Islam, Taoism, and Confucianism are all orthodox religions, all promote kindness and advise people to do good deeds. They are called religions, but they are actually like schools, helping people understand moral standards and spiritual enlightenment. It's just that the level and scope of knowledge taught is different, just like elementary, middle school, college, or university levels in this world. The knowledge that Buddhism teaches is the universal truth of the universe and life, it recognizes and includes all major religions, like a comprehensive university. Shakyamuni Buddha is the Principal of this university. Confucius taught his students the most basic knowledge about being human: Humanity, Righteousness, Respect, Wisdom, Trust, just like elementary school, he is the Principal who enlightens us. Lao Tzu teaches us how to strengthen our bodies, prolong our lives and develop our human potential on the basis of being human. He also studied the Five Elements, the Eight Trigrams, and the I Ching, striving to reach the realm of heaven and human unity, so that life would become more harmonious and fulfilling. I liken him to a high school principal.
Muhammad and Jesus are also spiritual leaders of many peoples, countries and people in the world
gender, like Principals of colleges or high schools. And these principals and teachers are all doctors, or we can say they are incarnations of the Buddhas and Bodhisattva. In order to save sentient beings, they open appropriate religions according to each locality, "using many bodies to save different sentient beings", this is similar to teaching depending on each person in the world. Therefore, when her daughter encountered doubts and difficulties and asked the Principal and university teachers for help, Muhammad would definitely be happy and supportive. Because, every teacher of noble virtue hopes that his students will improve.
My explanation cleared her doubts.
I told her again, tell your daughter to stop eating meat today and try reciting a Ksitigarbha Sutra for her fetus. As long as she recites it sincerely, it will definitely be effective. If one can persistently recite the seven sets of Ksitigarbha Sutras dedicating merit to the fetus, the debt between them will be eliminated. If it doesn't work, just go back to eating meat. If I say something wrong and offend Muhammad, not only will your daughter's recitation be ineffective, but I will also be punished. Having finished speaking, I gave her a copy of the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra in simplified text.
The next afternoon, she met me again in the neighborhood, happily thanked me and said that she had gone home and told her daughter what I said. She immediately believed and immediately washed her hands, cleaned the altar and started chanting sutras. The miracle is that from the time she started chanting sutras until now, the child is no longer disruptive, and her daughter finally has a good night's sleep. This is unprecedented in the past few months. Just now, her daughter finished reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra once, and still hasn't eaten a single piece of meat. She said that Buddha's teachings are so powerful. If she had known earlier and asked me, she would not have had to endure the suffering of the past few months!
Not long after, her daughter gave birth to a healthy, adorable baby boy whose birth was almost painless. During his confinement, he recited a set of Ksitigarbha Sutras every day, and now he almost knows them by heart. Later, she told me that her daughter used to love eating meat. The strange thing is that now just the smell of meat makes me nauseous, asking me if Buddha doesn't feed me anymore.
I told her that Buddha Bodhisattva is like Principals and teachers, they are responsible for teaching us knowledge. Whether or not you learn, or whether you apply it after learning or not, is the student's job. "Master leads you to the door, practice is personal." Buddha doesn't care whether you eat meat or not! The feeling of nausea when smelling meat is because chanting sutras has purified the body and mind, causing the Buddha's inherent nature to reveal himself, no longer accepting impure things like the flesh of living beings. Just eat more vegetables and bean products, your body will definitely be healthier than before.

tieu_de: PSYCHOLOGICAL ILLNESS
tom_tat: One day, a group of about forty or fifty 13 or 14 year old students from a sports school in Beijing organized a trip to Fanshan Mountain. There is a rock crevice on the mountain, the distance between the two cliffs is only about one edge...
noi_dung:
One day, a group of about forty or fifty 13 or 14 year old students from a sports school in Beijing organized a trip to Fanshan Mountain. There is a rock crevice on the mountain, the distance between the two cliffs is only about one meter apart. Looking down from the rock crevice, the height is about ten meters above the ground. Even brave little girls dare to jump over. When the teachers leading the group discovered it, they forbade the students from jumping over to avoid danger. But when the teacher left, some naughty students ran over to test their courage.
When student "little A" was about to jump, he turned around and smiled and said to his best friend "little B": "If I die, please inform my family!". Having finished speaking, he jumped over. Perhaps because he was busy talking, when his front leg just touched the opposite cliff, his back leg was still hanging in the air. For some reason, his front leg couldn't hold steady, his leg softened, he fell backwards and fell under the rock crevice. When his friends ran down to save him, his head hit a rock, blood flowed out, and he could no longer be saved.
A few days later, when "little A's" funeral ended, "little A's" family sadly went to the parking lot, "little B" also attended the funeral, suddenly came to "little A's" father, patted him on the shoulder and said: "Dad, please give me a cigarette!". The voice was indeed that of "little A", surprising "little A"'s father. When "little B" asked for cigarettes again, everyone around was confused because "little B" had never smoked, while "little A" often secretly smoked while he was still alive. Looking at "little B", although he smiled, his eyes glared, making everyone scared. His classmates had to take him home. After that, his parents took him everywhere to find a doctor for treatment. The doctor said this was due to mental stimulation, a symptom
mental illness. However, "little B" still persists in going to school every day, asserting that he is not sick. The strange thing is that the handwriting of "little B" has now become exactly the same as "little A".
It was fateful that Venerable Dieu Phap was at my house at that time. Teacher Ly brought "little B" and his parents to me. When "little B" came in, his eyes were dull, like a lost soul. After his parents told him the situation, Venerable Dieu Phap did not say anything. He only saw him bowing his head in compassion and gently praying the rosary. About three minutes later, he looked up and looked at "little B" and asked: "What's your name?"
The boy replied: "My name is little B." "How old are you this year?" "Fourteen."
His parents were happy, they heard his son's voice, and "little B's" eyes were back to normal. They pulled him to bow to the Venerable Dieu Phap. The Venerable said they should thank Buddha Bodhisattva, then they bowed in front of the Buddha statue at my house. When everyone asked Venerable Dieu Phap what happened. He said: "Little B" has a mental illness because "little A"'s consciousness doesn't want to leave. "Little A" said she was only fourteen years old, and before she could enjoy the happiness of the world, she had to die, very unjustly. Because "little B" is a good friend, "little A" enters "little B" to eat, drink, and smoke to satisfy.
Knowing this reason, I told "little A" that his premature death was due to karma killing his previous life. Now, if you do this, you will create new karma and will fall into the evil realm. I teach you to recite 'Namo Amitabha Buddha' to be reborn in a good place. Why do you have to enter other people and harm others and yourself? Finally, "little A" has awakened. Maybe you will be reborn in the human world, and in your next life you will have the opportunity to be close to Buddha's teachings."
"Little B's" parents were very happy when they heard that, saying that they would also start being vegetarian and study Buddha.

tieu_de: Chanting reciting mantras GREAT BIAS rebirth THE WATERS OF all Buddhas
tom_tat:
Ask: Many Buddhists know how to recite the Great Compassion Mantra. What is the effect of chanting the Great Compassion Mantra and what is the practice method?
Answer: In the Thousand Hands Thousand Eyes Great Compassion Da La Ni Sutra, it is said that Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva is the Right Destroyer...
noi_dung:
Ask: Many Buddhists know how to recite the Great Compassion Mantra. What is the effect of chanting the Great Compassion Mantra and what is the practice method?
Answer: In the Thousand Eyes Sutra of Great Compassion Da La Ni, it is said that Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva is the Dharma of the Tathagata in the past, achieving perfect merit, having great compassion, manifesting the Thousand Eyes to protect sentient beings in the dharma world, helping us develop a great Bodhi mind. He taught us to receive and uphold the Great Compassion and Great Compassion Da La Ni (Great Compassion Mantra), which helps us forever stay away from evil paths and be born before the Buddha. Even if we have committed serious sins that deserve to fall into Avici hell or are haunted by evil diseases, the Great Compassion Mantra will help eliminate them. Regularly chant the Great Compassion Mantra, wisdom will appear, and you will achieve eloquent Samadhi. All wishes in this life are fulfilled, without any doubt. We will quickly attain the three vehicles and soon reach Buddha status. The magical power of the Great Compassion mantra cannot be praised enough.
Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva promised Buddha that: If sentient beings recite the Great Compassion mantra and fall into the three evil realms, I swear I will not attain Buddhahood; If I recite the Great Compassion mantra without being born in the Buddha realm, I swear I will not attain Enlightenment; If I recite the Great Compassion mantra without achieving immeasurable Samadhi and eloquence, I swear I will not attain perfect enlightenment; If you recite the Great Compassion mantra but in this life your prayers are not fulfilled, then it is not Great Compassion Da La Ni.
Above are the great vows of Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva. Therefore, if we choose to recite the Great Compassion mantra as a daily retreat in this life, surely in this life everything will be as expected, and in the future we will definitely be reborn into the realm of Ultimate Bliss or the Buddha realms.
The method of chanting is as follows: If you are at home, you can go up to incense and worship in front of the Buddha statue, read the making vows verse and then recite it 21 times, 49 times or 108 times, depending on your decision. On the way to work or in your free time, you can recite it without counting the number of times. (The recitation ritual at the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas has instructions on the 8-step ritual:
Step 1: Reciting the Holy Name: Namo the Great Compassion Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva 3 times

tom_tat:
Step 3: Reciting the Holy Name: Namo Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva 108 times
Step 4: Reciting the Holy Name: Namo Amitabha Buddha 108 times Step 5: Sincerely recite the Great Compassion Mantra (5 or more times
than, the number of times is odd)
Step 6: Reciting the Sun Bodhisattva Da...
noi_dung:
Step 3: Reciting the Holy Name: Namo Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva 108 times
Step 4: Reciting the Holy Name: Namo Amitabha Buddha 108 times Step 5: Sincerely recite the Great Compassion Mantra (5 or more times
