Step 6: Reciting the Bodhisattva Da La Ni Light Step 7: Reciting Moonlight Bodhisattva Da La Ni Step 8: dedicating merit
Once you have memorized the Great Compassion Mantra, it only takes more than a minute to recite it once. If you are in a place where you are easily distracted, you can replace it by reciting the name "Namo Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva".
No matter which method you choose to practice, you must observe the pure precepts: Only by observing the five precepts (including not killing or eating meat) and practicing the ten virtues are true Buddhists. Practicing will definitely achieve inconceivable achievements.

tieu_de: HOW TO ELIMINATE THE CRIME OF ABORTION
tom_tat: Ask: In the Buddha Sutra, The Teaching of Long Life to Kill Sins for the Students of Da La Ni, it is said that abortion is an extremely great crime of killing lives, and the retribution is also very heavy. Why in the book Notes on modern cause and effect written by you...
noi_dung:
Ask: In the Buddha Sutra, The Teaching of Long Life to Kill Sins for the Students of Da La Ni, it is said that abortion is an extremely great crime of killing lives, and the retribution is also very heavy. Why is there no example of this in the book "Notes on modern cause and effect" written by you?
Answer: Abortion (abortion) is a crime of killing between husband and wife. This crime is worse than killing chickens, ducks, fish, pigs, cows, and goats. Many diseases arise from abortion. Venerable Dieu Phap encountered countless cases, especially heart disease, which is often found in women. Because it involves factors such as surgeons and legal policies, it is not convenient to tell stories about this. However, because there are currently too many questions related to this issue, please briefly explain as follows:
The state's population control policy is correct. All married couples must practice strict family planning. In cases of unwanted pregnancy, if abortion is required, the blame belongs to the parents themselves, so husband and wife need to be responsible for contraception. Abortion is the killing of a life, the retribution will be borne by oneself. Because "once you lose your human body, it will be difficult to get it back in ten lifetimes." I don't know how many lifetimes my consciousness entered the womb. Because I had a predestined relationship with you, I was reincarnated, but you aborted me. This child's resentment will be very difficult to eliminate. You cannot use the excuse of state policy to blame, because pregnancy is due to the couple's lust being too strong and not being careful.
careful in contraception, while the state's policy already exists.
Couples who believe in Buddha's teachings and have had abortions need to repent of the crime of abortion before Buddha and admit their fault to the child. Because you do not understand Buddha's teachings, ask the child for forgiveness, tell him about the suffering of the human world and advise him not to return to the human world. Encourage the child to recite "Namo Amitabha Buddha" several times, and yourself make vows chanting sutras Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva or Buddha's Longevity Sutra to Destroy Sins Protecting the Dalai Lama 3 times or 7 times (for each child). If you can kneel and chant, it's best to chant on your knees. If you sincerely do so, all kinds of diseases caused by abortion will be healed.
Medical staff involved in abortions need to be compassionate. Before and during the surgery, mentally recite "Namo Amitabha Buddha" for the fetus. If every day, in the morning or evening, you recite a set of sutras to save the fetus that day, you will have the compassion of a Bodhisattva (like reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra, Great Compassion Mantra, Universal Gate, etc.). Even though the medical staff is not the main responsible person, they are still participants, so they also have karma and will also have to suffer retribution. Therefore, following the above method will not only eliminate sins but also gain more merit.
Please carefully read the Buddha's Sutra on Longevity and Extermination of Sins for the Students of Da La Ni, you will receive immeasurable benefits.
Quoting Venerable Master Hsuan Hua's teachings on abortion and the delivery of unborn spirits:
Question: Venerable Master, there are a number of unmarried mothers who are causing many social problems, and then there is abortion... I wonder if the Venerable has any opinions or suggestions on this issue.
Venerable: You are talking about single mothers. Unfortunately, these people have lost their dignity, so they do not respect the rules before getting married. Nowadays, young people like dancing, watching movies, and singing. They enjoy eating, drinking, playing and finding pleasure. Passions and actions that lead to a loss of dignity, to the point where they lose consciousness of being human. As humans, we must have human behavior, but they are like demons - secretly not respecting the rules, wanting to try everything before getting married... and so, they became pregnant. Things like this may not be important in the West, but in China they are embarrassing.
This problem occurs due to just one ignorant thought: Men pursue women, women seek men... Because of ignorance, action karma follows, after action karma creates, name and form, six senses, contact, and feeling exist... All these things are created by ignorance... Due to confusion, love arises, followed by the desire to grasp (grasping and existence), and then many other problems appear... until old age and death (old age and death) come. This entire series of events is called the Dharma of the Twelve Causes and Conditions.
Because people do not understand the Twelve Causes and Conditions, they do things that are against morality. So their problem is getting bigger and bigger. When they became pregnant, things became even more complicated when instead of nurturing the fetus to give birth, they destroyed the fetus when it was between one and four months old.
The crime of abortion is very serious. You may think they are just small ghosts, but these ghosts have great spiritual powers that can make you die or bring you strange diseases, make you babble and confuse your mind until you go crazy... The crime of abortion is more serious than the crime of killing an adult. If you don't want children, why induce conception? At
Why such trouble? Unfortunately, men and women do not understand the ethics of being human, so these problems occur.
To solve these problems, we need to provide sexual education to young people, and teach them not to get involved in love until they are adults; otherwise, they will encounter difficult problems. We must push hard for them to follow these rules.
Venerable: Men and women treating each other decently is the foundation for national and world peace. If the husband does not behave like a husband; the wife does not behave like a wife; and children behave unchildishly, how can the world avoid chaos? I suggest that each person fulfill their role as husband or wife, not divorce, and take good care of their children. When every family is happy and harmonious, the nation will naturally have peace.
Additionally, I implore everyone to stop abortion! Think about it, if the sentient beings in the womb have become unjust souls before being born; With small wandering ghosts everywhere, how can society be peaceful? These little ghosts need to meet someone who is virtuous and not greedy for money to receive deliverance. It is very difficult to solve these problems, so with karma everywhere, how can there be peace?
Question: Abortion creates karma of killing living beings. Because I did not learn Buddha's teachings before, I committed the crime of killing without knowing it. What can I do to compensate for my karma?
Venerable: By doing more good blessings, by doing more repentance, and by reciting the Buddha's name more often.
Question: I heard that abortion is wrong in Buddhist teachings, but I committed this sin in the past without knowing it was wrong. What can I do now to make up for the harmful things I have done in the past?
Venerable: There is nothing better than correcting your own mistakes. Even though your sins are very great and fill the sky, if you sincerely repent and change, your sins will be wiped away.
Question: Nowadays there are many advertisements for "making offerings of fetus spirits" in daily newspapers and magazines. Can we make offerings of these fetus spirits, or should these fetus spirits be delivered?
Venerable: The word "making offerings" cannot be used in this sense, because the spirit of the fetus is not the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Sangha). If you consider it as making offerings of the unborn spirit, then you have fallen into wrong views. That must be called 'deliverance'. Delivering to sentient beings is not the same as making offerings to sentient beings, because delivering helps them to leave suffering and gain happiness. However, the spirit of the fetus carries a great resentment that is difficult to alleviate, because it is a debt that takes away life and must be repaid by giving life back. However, if those fetus spirits meet true monks who are not greedy for money, they have a chance to receive deliverance...
Question: Many people spend money to worship the spirits of fetuses. Can the hatred of these spirits of fetuses be compensated?
Venerable: Are not. There's no such thing as that easy.
Question: Nowadays, there are many people who take advantage of it to make money from others by saying that they can cure ghosts
linh thai nhi. There are Buddhists who do not approve of such actions. Dear Venerable Sir, what do you think? Will fetus spirits cause those who owe them illness or other problems? There are people who have had an abortion but are shy and afraid of wasting money and do not set up a tablet to pray for the fetus's soul. Venerable Bach, what do you think about this? Is it true that these spirits can cause trouble? If so, how to tame these unborn spirits? How can we comfort and make them happy?
Venerable: It is better not to have a tablet than to make one. What do I mean by that? One should not have an abortion in the first place; By preventing abortion, not killing. Because there is no killing, there is no need for a tablet. Asking for a tablet for a fetus spirit is "worrying about the top but forgetting the root", and is like "covering your ears to ring a bell", because it is self-deception. Can these spirits be delivered? Can this debt be resolved? The answer is unlikely. Therefore, it is better to prevent it from happening than to regret it later. Before getting married, you should not take birth control pills or have sex. Why can't we wait until marriage? Why such a hurry?
Venerable: cause and effect is never wrong by even a slight margin. We should be very careful not to kill. You kill it, it kills you and the killing of each other never stops. The above story is a case of receiving retribution in this life, everyone can see it. When we see this, we must believe that cause and effect are real. If you do not believe in cause and effect, karma reports, then when it is your turn to receive karma, it will be difficult for you to avoid karma even if you want to avoid it.
The most important thing today is that there are countless small devils in the world right now. Why are there so many little devils? It's because there are too many abortions. Those fetuses are killed before developing into human form. The hatred of these little demons is so deep that the precepts are not to kill and release animals, including not having an abortion. It's not easy to get rid of these little devils, so there's a saying: "The King of Hell is easy to meet but the little devil is difficult to deal with". Everyone should remember this point. Currently in the world in every country, there are more small devils (little devils) than big devils (great devils) and there are more big devils (great devils) than old devils (elder devils). The problem is really serious. We should know that all living beings have Buddha nature and can become Buddha. You should also know that all living beings have Bodhisattva nature and can become Bodhisattva. All living beings have the nature of Arhat and can become Arhat. All living beings have Pratyekabuddha nature and can become Pratyekabuddha. All living beings have divine nature and can be born in heaven. All living beings have human nature and can be human. All living beings have the nature of Asura and can become Asura. All living beings have ghost nature and can become ghosts. If you do devilish things then you are a devil. If you continue to do animal things, you are an animal. All sentient beings have the nature of beings in hell. If you keep planting causes for hell, sooner or later you will fall into hell. No matter what cause you plant, you will receive that result. Absolutely never make mistakes.
Excerpt from Venerable Master Hsuan Hua Dich Buddha's contribution to the study of the treatise: About abortion and praying for the soul of the fetus
The monk raised the problem that the karma of abortion is "this resentment is too deep", it is difficult to deliverance, one needs to be a monk.
Only by not being greedy for money can there be a chance to deliver to them. Therefore, everyone must not be superstitious and think that using money to create a lot of merit will result in a "smooth" delivery. If you do that, then you don't understand cause and effect, turning the root into the top. Besides, in the Buddhist scriptures, it is also repeated that one must not kill or have an abortion.
For example, in the Buddha Sutra, The Teaching of Longevity and Destroying the Guardians of the Students of Da La Ni, it is written: "There are five things in the world that are difficult to destroy even if there is repentance. What is the year? 1) Kill your father; 2) kill his mother; 3) killing the unborn fetus; 4) causing the Buddha's body to bleed; 5) breaking the harmony increases. Such evil karma is difficult to destroy."
In the Buddha's Sutra, the Theory of Karma and the Discourse of the Buddha has a passage that says: "There are ten types of karma that can cause living beings to suffer a short life: 1) do the killing yourself; 2) encourage others to kill... 7) destruction of fetal organs (i.e. self-induced abortion); 8) telling others to destroy (i.e. advising others to have an abortion)... The ten karmas mentioned above bring the karma of short life."
In addition, in the Buddha Sutra on the Upasakas of the Five Precepts, the Buddha said: "If someone intends to have an abortion and the fetus dies, that person has committed a crime that cannot be repentance."
Indeed, the Venerable also did spirit delivery ceremonies for sentient beings, but the Venerable only said very modestly: "All my life, I never wanted to participate in following the rituals of 'chanting sutras, repentance, releasing flames, water and water', because I did not have enough virtue, not enough morality to move people, not enough virtue to educate people. You haven't been able to deliver yourself yet, so how can you deliver the souls? So, I don't dare
"So bold"!"
But today, not only are there "spirit delivery centers" popping up everywhere, but there are also "prices" set depending on the situation. Even lay people participate in this practice. These people who specialize in using deliverance to make money are really pagans who have infiltrated Buddha's door!
The monk taught that: "Now is the age of the end of the dharma, the 'white-clothed' ('white-clothed' people) arbitrarily accept making offerings from others. Those who lay back also arbitrarily chant sutras for others, perform deliverance ceremonies for others, collect money from others, "rely on Buddha to wear clothes, rely on Buddha to eat food". Those who shake can deliverance to others, so who will deliverance to themselves? Don't say lay people, even people leaving the home life who chant sutras, perform repentance ceremonies, and deliver spirits to make money, are all problems!"
Translator's comment: In Vietnam, we are no exception. The issue of abortion also happens a lot, but young men and women, parents cannot predict the consequences and karma of abortion. Satisfying desire for a moment but holding grudges for a lifetime. Those of you who have had abortions, after reading this article, I hope everyone will be alert, develop a mind to repent, worship Buddha, worship, fast, chant sutras, recite Buddha's name, do many good deeds,... create many merits dedicating merit to the spirit of the aborted fetus. Pray for the soul to be liberated and reborn in a good world. Only then can this hatred be resolved.
When translating this article, I remembered a very good saying of Dharma Master Thai Le Huc when teaching Disciple Quy: “Society is really chaotic now, to the extreme. People laugh at the poor, not at the prostitutes." That's right, it's because society is in chaos to the extreme, morality
Virtue has been lost, so such a serious abortion phenomenon occurs. A young man and woman who were only eighteen or twenty in love with each other, not for the sake of building a good family, but had sex with each other leading to pregnancy and then abortion. It's all because morality has deteriorated too much. Who knows that ahead is an abyss, if you miss a step there is no way back.

tieu_de: MILITARY COLLEGE
tom_tat: Layman Quan Nghia in Jilin suffered from an incurable disease and was brought home from the hospital by relatives and friends to wait for death. After that, he met a wise man who guided him, observed the five precepts and practiced the Buddha's recitation method. Miraculously, he...
noi_dung:
Layman Quan Nghia in Jilin suffered from an incurable disease and was brought home from the hospital by relatives and friends to wait for death. After that, he met a wise man who guided him, observed the five precepts and practiced the Buddha recitation method. Miraculously, he recovered. From then on, he became even more diligent in reciting Buddha's name.
One day, while reciting Buddha's name, he saw Amitabha Buddha and Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva suddenly appear before him, making him extremely excited. Another day while reciting Buddha, he found himself in hell, witnessed many sinners being tortured and screaming for his help. He said: "Right now I don't know how to save you." From then on, Quan Nghia and his wife diligently read the sutras, paid homage to the Buddha, recited the Buddha's name, then eliminated killing, religion, lust, and delusion, and kept mindfulness every day when walking, standing, lying, and sitting. Currently, he has the intention of leaving the home life to repay Buddha's favor. Quan Nghia went everywhere to learn from his friends about where to leave the home life and which teacher was good to follow.
The first emptiness is the meditation mind. Purity of Amitabha within the mind; Laughing, being happy, being angry, and scolding are all Pham Am Pho to help lay people;
Save yourself and save others to attain the golden body."
Layman Quan Nghia read the verse and continuously worshiped the scriptures. From then on, he practiced more diligently and no longer sought anything outside.

tieu_de: EATING VEGAN, chanting sutras IS AMAZING
tom_tat: I am a girl named Tran Hi, 20 years old this year, and have just started studying Buddhism for less than four months. However, since believing and studying Buddha, the things that have happened to our three-generation family have truly made...
noi_dung:
I am a girl named Tran Hi, 20 years old this year, and have just started studying Buddhism for less than four months. However, since believing and studying Buddha, the things that happened to our three-generation family really shook the whole family's mind. Therefore, I want to tell this story to good and knowledgeable friends, hoping everyone can share the joy with us and thereby receive some benefits.
When I was young, I had mumps, and then I became deaf in my right ear. In fourth grade, I had myocarditis and not only had to miss school but also had to be hospitalized. But one wave after another, not long after being discharged from the hospital, I was discovered to have hepatitis A and had to be hospitalized for infectious diseases. The doctor said it was lucky he arrived in time, otherwise his life would have been in danger. These two serious illnesses scared my parents. I also suffered a lot, and my body became weaker and weaker. For nourishment, my parents often take me to restaurants to eat delicious and nutritious dishes. I only choose to eat nutritious dishes such as large shrimp, turtles, crabs, silkworm pupae, etc. However, no matter how nutritious I eat, my body still does not get stronger, on the contrary, it becomes weaker and sicker.
When I was 17 years old, misfortune struck again. During class, I suddenly had a headache, then was taken to the hospital, and was in a coma for five days and five nights. When I woke up, I couldn't recognize words and couldn't even do simple addition and subtraction. The doctor diagnosed me with a congenital cerebrovascular malformation - brain bleeding, and recommended skull surgery. So my long hair was shaved off... The surgery was very successful
public. But the joy was short-lived. Eight months after surgery, I had a seizure again, said to be a sequela after surgery. My parents took me to all major hospitals, spending a lot of money, I also suffered a lot of pain, I also took Chinese medicine and acupuncture for more than two years but the disease did not improve. Even though I was weak and sick from a young age, it didn't change my lively, cheerful, and resilient personality. Only this time, I was overcome, accepted my fate, both my body and mind were sick, I lived in insecurity all day, I was worried, scared, always worried that the seizure would reoccur, so my nearly 80 year old grandmother had to come every day to take care of me.
I also used to resent heaven and blame others, feeling that God was so unfair to me; Until January of this year, I read the book Notes on modern cause and effect by layperson Qua Khanh, every word and sentence was like a thunderbolt in my ear: "Cooking meat and frying fish to satisfy the taste buds, not knowing that the animal's heart is not willing... Consciousness is sent to you, sooner or later it will reclaim your life...". I always looked for outside treatment, but never examined myself: "Disease comes from the mouth", this is all caused by me eating the flesh of living beings! So I decided to become a vegetarian. But my parents thought my body was too weak and not suitable for vegetarianism, so they told me to wait until I was healthy before talking. Reluctantly, I had to eat the three pure meats (3 types of pure meat) first.
Maybe it's fate! In April, I met Ms. Duong, a believer in Buddha. I did not expect that she would also benefit from the book Notes on modern cause and effect. This further strengthens my belief in learning Buddhist vegetarianism.
Not long after, I met Venerable Dieu Phap. I told him about my illness. As soon as he opened his mouth, he surprised me: "You really like to eat seafood
no?". "Yes! How do you know?". "Moreover, my heart often hurts like needles." I was heartbroken and nodded continuously. "If you can give up all salty foods, and sincerely repentance, as all sentient beings have eaten (especially seafood), diligently chanting the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutras every day, reciting the Ksitigarbha Sutra 7 times, 21 times or 49 times, dedicating merit to them, your illness will definitely be cured."
That night, because the teacher rubbed my head, I had a severe headache and could not eat rice. My mother was very scared and kept chanting "Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva". Around 8 o'clock, I started vomiting. At first my mother thought I was sick again; The third time I vomited, it was all white phlegm. At that moment, my heart lit up, I felt very comfortable, and my mother was also relieved. The next morning when I woke up, I no longer had a headache. From that day on I started a vegetarian diet, and every day recited one set of the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra; First, classify the 7-day recitation (for example: seafood), then celebrate for 49 days (for example: Shrimp), to this day I still continue to chant.
Day by day, my spirit and appearance are getting better and better. The previous fear and anxiety have now disappeared, leaving only growing confidence. Now my grandmother can also "take leave", I can go out or stay at home alone, my family feels secure, everyone who meets me says I'm very different from before. It was Buddha Bodhisattva who saved me!
Since I became a vegetarian, my mother, to strengthen my faith, also stopped eating salty foods. The good news is: Because my mother observed the precepts as a vegetarian, she became much younger. Some people even mistook her and me for sisters. Moreover, her illness could not be cured. A year ago, my mother had a uterine cyst on her right ovary. At that time the doctor said: "We have to monitor it and if we grow older we have to have surgery." In September this year, I went for another checkup, the ultrasound results were completely normal, Mom
Hearing the results, I couldn't believe it. I asked the doctor to check again. The doctor seriously checked the entire abdomen again and said: "Everything is normal, there is only a small cyst, it does not affect anything!". When my mother announced the results to me with a face full of joy, we said in unison: "Amitabha Buddha, Buddha Bodhisattva blesses!". From then on, my mother became even more diligent.
Next is my grandfather's story! This year he is 81 years old, had stomach cancer and had surgery to remove three-quarters of his stomach. A year ago, he was diagnosed with sludge gallstones. Because of his age, he did not have surgery. But this year, his face became worse and worse, he even went downstairs less and less, he only ate one meal a day and his stomach was always uncomfortable. I felt very sad. Suddenly, I remembered that in the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra, it is said: "If in the future, there will be men and women, lying in bed for a long time, praying for life and not being able to pray for death..." So I called Mrs. Duong to ask how to chant the sutras for him. She told me to recite one set of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutras for him every day, for a total of seven days. At the same time, you also need to coordinate reciting the Buddha's name (Namo Amitabha Buddha), and recite it regularly.
The first night, he started having diarrhea, but he was naturally constipated. Every time he defecated, he had to rely on medicine and rarely excreted naturally, so the whole family found it strange. The second day, my stomach was upset again, I wanted to go to the hospital but couldn't go, because every movement was painful; At night, around 8 o'clock, he started vomiting. The family was very worried, but because of my experience, they faced it more calmly. Like me, the third time he vomited it was all white phlegm. At about 9 o'clock, he started having diarrhea again. He was able to sit up on his own and wanted to eat. On the fourth day, he got better and got out of bed to play chess with his neighbors. Then needless to say, now that he is also a vegetarian, I believe his health will get better and better.
This is a true story that happened in three generations of my family. This makes us believe in the power of Buddha Dharma, it is truly inconceivable! Therefore, "Do not do evil, but do good." Finally, I want to remind everyone that: Fasting chanting sutras early in the day brings benefits. Buddha Dharma is truly a wonderful Dharma, and that magic is endless!
Namo Amitabha Buddha. Disciple of the Three Jewels Kuo Hi pays homage.
33 YEARS AS A CRAZY PERSON
Lam Vi, 67 years old this year, has excellent karma from Fudan University (Shanghai) in 1964. He knows four foreign languages: English, French, German and Japanese. Have ever been assigned to work for a state agency. That year, he married Vuong Lan, who was 4 years younger than him. By 1966 when the Great Cultural Revolution broke out, they had a son and a daughter.
In those years, just knowing one foreign language could be suspected of "liaising with foreign countries", let alone someone who knew four foreign languages like him. Obviously Lam Vi became the subject of denunciation, almost every three days he was brought to the hall to be denounced, explained why he learned so many foreign languages, or had to go with "reactionaries" to parade around the streets to shame him. His honest and introverted nature makes him speak less and not defend himself, which is considered "resisting to the end," and that of course is "the way to die"!
During a denunciation session, Lam Vi, who was always quiet, suddenly laughed and cried erratically - he went crazy. After a few days of detention, when it was confirmed that he was truly crazy, people informed his wife, Vuong Lan, to come take him home. At this time, Lam Vi became a dull person, his eyes were lifeless, he did not know whether he was hungry or full, he did not know how to control himself when going to the toilet, and did not say another word. People reported that he was crazy here in the sense that he did not hit people, did not curse, and did not make noise.
At that time, Vuong Lan was the wife of an element "in contact with foreign countries". Although many people stay away, luckily there are still a few dozen salaries each month to maintain a living for a family of four. There was no treatment for her husband's illness, and even if there was, no one would dare to treat him.
Vuong Lan is not a weak woman. She has to take care of her two small children and serve her husband who can go to the bathroom at any time in bed or in his pants. Her difficulties and hardships are hard to imagine. However, she never let her husband go hungry or overeat, and although his clothes were patched, they were always neat and clean. The house is always bright, never has a bad smell. This touched and complimented her friends and neighbors who visited her house.
Her husband's younger brother clearly understood her sister-in-law's suffering and once advised her to divorce her brother. He said: "My brother can't be cured, if only you divorce him, his agency will definitely send him to a mental hospital, then you will suffer less when you still have to raise two children." Vuong Lan said: "I understand your kindness, but I have married your brother, I am his life partner, whether rich or poor, healthy or sick, I will always be by his side for life, sharing both joy and shame. Otherwise, why are they still called husband and wife? If I have this disease, will you also advise your brother to divorce me?"
The sister-in-law's words made the brother-in-law cry.
After the country stabilized, policies were gradually implemented, and people's lives increasingly improved.
Through introduction, Vuong Lan took refuge in Buddha Dharma. Since then, she often reads some Buddhist books in her free time and participates in meditation activities when organized by the temple. Every day, she recites Buddha's name, using it to comfort her suffering heart.
When Vuong Lan had the opportunity to meet Venerable Dieu Phap in 2001, she was a 63-year-old woman. At this time, her husband, Lam Vi, had not said a word for 33 years.
The monk, after listening to Vuong Lan tell his story, helped her find out the cause and effect from Lam Vi's past life, causing him to suffer such retribution in this life.
When the Japanese first invaded China (1931), the government at that time did not actively fight against the Japanese, causing opposition from the people. Students regularly organize street protests, calling on the government to resist Japan. The government, to stop the protests, sent police to arrest some students for investigation. Among them, a male student could not stand the threat and confessed that the protest was not organized by him, but was led by two other male students and one female student. These three people were arrested and asked to confess and admit their mistakes at a student meeting organized by the police, and announced the cancellation of the protest. But these three people not only did not admit their mistakes, but also took advantage of the meeting to shout protest slogans and sing anti-Japanese songs, making the authorities angrily declare them crazy and put them in a mental hospital. Each person was imprisoned separately in a small room, not allowed to go out, not allowed to meet other people. At first, there were people who brought them food and emptied toilets, but as the war became more and more fierce, for many days no one brought them food or emptied toilets anymore. Gradually, these three people really went crazy, not knowing how to be hungry or full, not having control over going to the bathroom, and not long after that they died one after another. As for the male student who reported and was released, he also died in chaos not long after.
The Venerable said: "Your husband is the student who revealed the secret of the protest in his previous life. Khi
The strength of her husband and children was still strong, they could not penetrate, but when he was denounced and his spirit collapsed. It's because I didn't leave my husband when he went crazy, took good care of him, and recited Buddha's name every day that I had this opportunity. But to change your husband's fate, you need to do three things:
“First, are you vegetarian?”
"Dear teacher, I take refuge in the Buddha gate but still eat the three pure flesh."
"You should abstain from eating meat. Eating meat means killing, eating the three pure flesh is only a means for beginners to learn Buddha. Can you do it?"
"Yes, I can do it."
"Second, you should replace your husband and sincerely repentance before the Buddha statue with those three student souls. My husband in his previous life was forced to reveal it, he did not intend to harm anyone, and has suffered retribution for decades, please forgive him."
Third, you should alternately chant the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutras for those three people, with devotion, to deliver them to the good path and take refuge in the Three Jewels. Recite at least once a day, recite with sincerity, without haste, to have great merit, until they are touched by your sincerity and are influenced by Buddha's teachings, and forgive your husband. Can you do it?"
"Yes, teacher, I can do it. I will start today." A month later, when I returned from Wutai Mountain, fellow practitioner
Guo Neng told me that a layperson named Truong called to report that Lam Vi had opened his mouth to speak and knew how to go to the bathroom on his own. When Layman Wang went out with him, he greeted him
asked the neighbors, making everyone in the neighborhood very surprised and happy. The crazy person who didn't know anything for 33 years has now recovered the ability to recognize and express language. This is unbelievable!
Hearing this news, I was very touched and wanted to meet Mr. Lam. Before leaving, I brought with me a copy of the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra in traditional characters. I thought that Lin Wei had also been a student. If he really recovered, he would definitely recognize the traditional characters.
At layman Vuong Lan's house, I met Mr. Lam. He was not tall, thin, his teeth had all fallen out, he had no dentures, but his eyes were very magical, looking like someone who had just recovered from a serious illness. Many upstairs neighbors also came. Layman Vuong pointed to a few neighbors and asked if he recognized them. He said: "I realized, they often come to our house." Some neighbors were so happy that they cried. Layman Vuong pointed at me and asked if he recognized me. He looked at me and said: "Never been there, don't recognize it." Everyone applauded again. I gave him the Ksitigarbha Sutra and asked him to read it. He read every word without error, he read the entire eulogy, receiving applause and joyful laughter!
I know that these applause and laughter are a celebration of Buddha's dharma and a congratulation to the lay Vuong Lan family.

tieu_de: Buddha Dharma GIVES ME A NEW LIFE
tom_tat: While rearranging the bookshelf, I accidentally discovered a copy of a letter that a medical worker with terminal liver cancer (he himself only knew it was liver disease) wrote to Venerable Master Hsuan Hua after studying...
noi_dung:
While rearranging the bookshelf, I accidentally discovered a copy of a letter that a medical worker with terminal liver cancer (he only knew it was liver disease) wrote to Venerable Master Hsuan Hua after studying Buddha and recovering from his illness. Reading this letter again, I feel it can be helpful for those new to Buddhism and practicing meditation, so I would like to post it to serve readers.
My name is Van Tan Sinh (fake name I gave myself. It means that after reading the teachings of Venerable Master Hsuan Hua at the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, I have a new life - Note by Qua Khanh), 58 years old this year, I have been working in a hospital ever since.
In July 1989, I became diabetic. By June 1990, he had liver disease again: In September 1991, the liver disease got worse, examination showed that it was early stage cirrhosis and there was fluid in the abdomen. By June 1992, liver disease and diabetes became more serious, fluid appeared in the abdomen for the second time, fever was as high as 40.03 degrees Celsius, the lowest was 37.38 degrees Celsius, continuously lasting more than a month. After being hospitalized for more than a year, although the condition has improved, some indicators still have to be maintained with medication. At that time, my friends were all very concerned about my health, my wife and son were also very worried, found me the most famous doctors in the country, took a few hundred oriental medicine recipes, gave a few hundred bottles of fluid and nearly a hundred tubes of protein, spending more than 60,000 Yuan (about more than 7,000 US dollars) in medical expenses. It also didn't have a good effect, just a slight improvement, and the condition was roughly controlled.
In early 1993, a friend named Vuong gave me a qigong book. I finished reading and followed what the book taught for a while, but I couldn't persevere, I just interrupted. The book talks about ideas and visualizations such as sitting on lotus flowers, pagodas, Buddha statues and also talks about sitting, lying down, standing, reciting Buddha. After that, a lady named Bach introduced us to a man named Tran from the Northeast. They took me and my wife to Dai Bi Pagoda in Tianjin, paid homage to the Buddha, asked for scriptures, asked for statues of Ksitigarbha Vuong Bodhisattva, Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, and consecration. After returning, in order to clearly understand these principles, we looked up dictionaries, read scriptures, and studied very hard. We didn't know where to start, but we didn't stop.
On January 1, 1994, through introduction, I met Venerable Dieu Phap. The old Venerable used a few sentences to describe my personality and personality. At that time, what he said made me deeply impressed. I felt that every word and every sentence was very true, without any superfluous words: like the Venerable is who I am. Then the Venerable talked about my health again, saying I had liver disease, diabetes, my kidneys were not good, and my liver had two small tumors. Say this is the effect, but what is the cause? Said I had killed people, eaten turtles, eels, crabs, large shrimp, pigeons and snake meat, and said I used my left hand to shoot a gun, injuring the wing of a small bird, and that bird later died. At that time, it was very difficult for me to understand why my illness was related to the lives I had killed. Even the fact that I used my left hand to shoot a gun, you knew clearly! It's amazing.
When I was still skeptical, the Venerable advised me to read Venerable Master Hsuan Hua's Teaching Collection. He said: "Venerable Master Hsuan Hua teaches his disciples to follow the five precepts, the ten virtues, and to be virtuous people. We must repent every day, from the depths of our hearts, realize our mistakes, be determined not to violate the five precepts, and reform our evil ways." This
suggested a lot to me. I felt these words were so realistic and profound, at that time I thought: "Being human must follow what the Great Master taught." The Venerable saw that I was very sincere, so he instructed me on how to chant Buddha, how to repentance, and helped me liberate the sentient beings that I had killed from my body. Immediately I felt light throughout my body, as if my illness had disappeared. After that, he patted my whole body. I felt like the heavy, tattered cotton clothes that I had worn for many years from top to bottom had been taken off and onto the ground. At that moment, my whole body became hot, and slowly this feeling moved from top to bottom, my whole body felt extremely relieved, it really felt like the illness had been healed immediately.
After that, a layperson named Manh gave us books such as The Legend of Venerable Master Hsuan Hua, Information on Buddhist monks, Introduction to meditation, and a handwritten copy of the Great Compassion Mantra for us to see. After that, we also went to the Great Compassion Temple in Tianjin several times to ask for the Great Compassion Mantra, the Shurangama Mantra, Venerable Master Hsuan Hua's teaching collection and sutra books such as Explanation of the Shurangama Sutra and Explanation of the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra taught by Venerable Master Hsuan Hua.
From then on, we persistently meditated, repentance, recited Buddha's name, recited the Great Compassion Mantra, and studied scriptures. In the early stages of meditation, my legs are numb and my legs hurt, and I can only sit for a few dozen minutes at a time. Then, gradually adapting, the meditation time also increased, from ten minutes to twenty minutes, half an hour, forty minutes, fifty minutes, one hour. During this process, there are times when you feel sleepy, but that quickly passes. After meditating for three or four months, the body began to tremble. After a while, while meditating, my whole body gets hot and sweats profusely. Each time I meditate, it feels like I just took a bath. This phenomenon lasts two or three months.
One day in between, that is, two or three days after Venerable Dieu Phap left for America, that night my wife told me that Venerable Master Dieu Phap, who came to America, would definitely tell Venerable Master Hsuan Hua about my situation. As a result, the next morning while meditating, Venerable Master Hsuan Hua appeared before my eyes, advising me to study Buddha diligently. This was the first time I saw an image while meditating. The appearance of this image encouraged me a lot, making me steadfast in my belief that I must study Buddhism.
Later, while meditating, the lives that I had killed appeared before my eyes such as snakes, porcupines, tortoises, frogs, lizards, eels, they all lay on the table and did not want to go. I admitted my mistake, apologized, bowed my head, chanted Buddha for them, saw that they were all satisfied and left, I was also very happy.
Another time, while meditating, I saw an image of a temple and a person appear. This person was a monk holding a whisk, leading me into the temple, but several times I couldn't get there. There was also a time when I was meditating, and a monk took me to meet Buddha Maitreya. Buddha Maitreya led me into a large temple and met Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva. I immediately knelt down on the ground and bowed. Buddha Maitreya sat next to Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, then he used his hand to lift my shoulders, letting me sit on his lap. I said that I was already an adult and still sat on his lap. He said: "In front of me, no matter how old you are, you are still just a child." Then I returned to the form of a small child.
Another time, while meditating, I followed Buddha Maitreya to a very far place, where there were mountains, pagodas, and a very vast landscape. There were many Buddhas in the temple. I knelt down and bowed. Suddenly my eyes lit up. I looked up and saw a bright ball of fire. Later, when I read the book The Legend of Venerable Master Hsuan Hua, I learned that it was Buddha's spectral projection. Later when I
Seeing the photos that Venerable Dieu Phap brought back from the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas in America, my heart was so happy that I couldn't say anything. It was unexpected - the place with mountains, pagodas, and vast scenery that I saw that day was the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas!
A few days later, while meditating, I saw a lot of cockroaches on my body. At that time, I chanted Buddha's name and used my hand to push them down. The children left and then came back. When I didn't know what to do, Buddha Maitreya appeared before my eyes again, using his hand to push each cockroach off my body. Since then, the itchy red spots on my skin disappeared, and my skin no longer itched. Another time, while meditating, Buddha Maitreya gently massaged my liver, removing impurities from it and said: "Gradually it will go away." After that, Buddha Maitreya tested my pancreas function and found that the insulin secreted was very little, only one drop every half a day. Buddha Maitreya says: "Insulin pipes are not smooth, the amount of insulin secreted is not enough." So Buddha Maitreya used a small stick to clear the duct, then massaged twice more, the insulin sprayed out as much as a large needle, he said that was enough. After that, he led me to a water tank to bathe, wash off the dirt and viruses on my body, and then change my clothes. Since then, my health has gotten better and better. Standing with healthy people, no one realizes that I was once seriously ill.
After a while, I went for a check-up at the hospital. The doctors were very surprised, because according to my condition, it should have gotten worse, the best thing to do was to keep the disease from getting worse. But my situation is different, many indicators have reached normal levels, for example: Albumin index, previously requiring albumin infusion to maintain 35, 36, the highest was 38, now without albumin infusion it has reached 40, 41. Some other indicators, although not yet reaching normal levels, are also tending to improve. A patient asked me: "What method do you use to treat it?". I said: "I follow the path of a new life!"
After nearly ten months of meditation, repentance, and studying scriptures, my understanding of Buddhism has become one step deeper: From the initial theoretical things that I understand, I feel that Buddhism is beneficial to the country, the people, and a good society. If the whole world followed the requirements of Buddhism, there would be no war, robbery, theft, or fraud, the world would be peaceful, and we would have a happy and fulfilling life. Another feeling is that the issues that Buddhism addresses are not imagination, not even superstition, but very profound science. If you can practice according to the requirements of Buddha dharma sincerely, you can dispel diseases and achieve unexpected results. Therefore, why are some people with incurable or serious illnesses able to live strong lives, and live as long as possible, thanks to this argument. From my own recovery and change, I can also prove this argument.

tieu_de: MASTER DIEU THANH
tom_tat:
Recently someone asked me what "selfless appearance" is and how to get rid of "selfless appearance". Because I myself have not yet attained this realm, it is difficult to answer satisfactorily.
Buddha teaches us: "If you want to end all suffering, you must...
noi_dung:
Recently someone asked me what "selfless appearance" is and how to get rid of "selfless appearance". Because I myself have not yet attained this realm, it is difficult to answer satisfactorily.
Buddha teaches us: "If you want to end all suffering, you must meditate and know that there is enough. Dharma knows enough, that is, a place of peace and prosperity. People who know enough will still be happy even if they lie on the ground. People who don't know enough will not be satisfied even in heaven. People who don't know enough are rich but poor. People who know enough are poor but rich. People who do not know enough are always pulled by the five desires, and are pitied by those who know enough. This is called knowing enough. Based on the contemplation of knowing enough, develop the mind of great Bodhi and overcome yourself. Eliminate worry about yourself and expand your concern for humanity and sentient beings. Forgetting yourself, uniting with sentient beings, loving all sentient beings, feeling the suffering of sentient beings, thinking what sentient beings think, doing what sentient beings do, completely without thoughts of competition, selfishness, or self-interest with sentient beings, this is a practice process to eliminate the appearance of ego.
Regarding what "selfless appearance" is, in addition to those who practice to the realm of selflessness as mentioned above, there are also people who seem to be born with differences, that is, "selfless appearance", "non-discriminating". When I think of this, I think of the layperson Dieu Thanh, who recently took refuge in the Great Venerable The Quang. Her person and her work are truly extraordinary. I want to tell my fellow practitioners, I don't know if it is related to "non-self appearance" or not.
Layperson Dieu Thanh, whose last name is Quoc, is a woman over 40 years old. She is the Director of a private company, her workload is quite significant.
You could say she's like a young woman, because she really is like a young woman. Over 40 years old, her appearance is still very beautiful. People who don't know her, if they only hear her laughter as clear as a silver bell, will definitely think she is a 17 or 18 year old girl, because her laughter is full of innocence. The Dharma name "Dieu Thanh" that the Great Venerable The Quang gave her was very appropriate. If you compare her purity to a stream flowing quietly in the deep mountains and forests, or as pure as the white snow on Kunlun Mountain, you certainly won't believe it.
"Her intentions are not evil", is the common assessment of those who know her - whether they are long-time acquaintances or friends who just met her for the first time. Layperson Dieu Thanh speaks very skillfully, wherever she is there is often laughter.
Say she is a young woman, but she is different from other young women. She never uses any kind of cosmetics, nor is she good at makeup, not because she doesn't love beauty, but because she believes that nature is beautiful, beauty created by makeup is fake, not the real self. In her eyes, complicated life events are like smoke passing through her eyes. Therefore, the way she treats people is like a knife cutting through water, not rejecting anyone who comes, not leaving a trace when she leaves, and being open-minded, not every normal man can compare to that virtue.
For example, her employee, if someone says bad things or causes scandal, when she finds out, she will immediately criticize harshly, regardless of whether there is anyone around or whether the other person is embarrassed or not. But as long as the other person knows their mistake and is willing to correct it, she will immediately forgive and say: "It's okay, go to work." The next time I saw that person again, she still called me sisters, very close. If there are regular employees
Coming out late and coming home early, even lasting up to two or three hours, when something reflects on her, she will immediately call that person over. As long as the other person gives a reason, even though she knows it is a lie, she will nod in confidence and say: "Next time something happens, remember to let me know" and let it go. She never deducts other people's wages, saying: "Going out to make money is not easy, let it go." Don't think this is a working method or leadership art, this is completely an expression of her soul. Such things happen to her so often that even her business clients say: "Director Quoc is such a kind, generous, and pure person that you can't bear to deceive and hurt her." That's why, for a simple and unscheming Director like her, the company's sales grow every year. When others praise her for being blessed, she will certainly say it is the result of the efforts of other leaders.
There are also things that make others admire! When she talks to others, she may accidentally compliment a man that he is handsome, elegant, and kind. Even when that man is present, or even in front of her husband, she doesn't care what others think, and no one really thinks badly of her.
If she wants to show someone some photos or something else, she will arbitrarily sit next to that person without caring if that person is male or female. Later, if someone reminded her to pay attention to these issues, she seemed to realize it and smiled and said: "I never had that thought in my mind!"
If she and her male karma partner go on a long business trip, because she is timid and does not dare to be alone in the room, she will sleep on an empty bed in the male karma partner's room. And when she returns to the company, she will freely tell others,
Even telling it in front of that karma's wife, no one said anything. No one spoke ill of her, on the contrary, the wife of that male karma male felt secure when her husband went on business trips with the National Director, never worrying about anything going wrong. Because you can't find any signs of evil in her eyes, words or gestures, or maybe you never think to look for those signs. You see, I've known her for less than half a year and already know so many stories about her. In addition to what I saw and felt when I went to Nam Hoa Pagoda with her, there are also stories told to me by her karma, of course there are also stories she told herself. I wonder if readers can already have a preliminary view of layperson Dieu Thanh?
It seems like everyone wants to talk to her, it seems like her clear laughter can dispel sorrows and forget worries every time you laugh happily with her. Every time I am in such a situation, I think of "the direct mind is the ashram" and the meaning of Buddha's teachings in "Four pure and clear repentance": "If Bhikkhus, if their minds are as straight as the strings of a guitar, everything is true, they will enter the samadhi, and there will never be any evil things." “The mind is as straight as a string, everything is true”, perhaps referring to people like layperson Dieu Thanh.
When I stood behind Venerable The Quang, using a camera to record the scene of lay practitioner Dieu Thanh and his fellow practitioners kneeling to listen to the master's teachings, from the respectful and focused eyes of lay practitioner Dieu Thanh, I realized that she had deep good roots - even though I did not have wisdom like Venerable Dieu Phap. After that, our group of seven continued to go south, to Nam Hoa Pagoda in Guangdong to pay respects to the body of the Sixth Patriarch, a body that has existed for 1,500 years. When he bowed his head for the first time, layman Dieu Thanh raised his head and saw the body of the Sixth Patriarch sitting on his palms. Even though she
She knew very little about Buddhism, but in her heart she understood that this was the current holy realm. Looking further, the Sixth Patriarch's fleshly body was still sitting on the altar, identical to the image before her eyes, making her emotional and happy to the point of tears. As we stood around her, we didn't know what had happened. After sister Dieu Dung helped her stand up, she still cried for a while before recounting the incident and saying that before the ceremony, she saw Luc To blink his eyes and his lips move slightly, as if he wanted to say something. The realm that layperson Dieu Thanh saw made everyone admire him greatly.
This holy scene later appeared again at Bach Ma Temple in Luoyang, when she bowed her head to pay respect to the Amitabha Buddha statue, a large pink lotus flower appeared again on her palms. Looking up, Amitabha Buddha's eyes were looking at her compassionately. When layperson Dieu Thanh told us about it, I suddenly understood why in Buddhism, bowing to the Buddha is called "bowing to the Buddha" and with both palms facing up. Venerable Dieu Phap once said that whoever sincerely pays homage to the Buddha, the Buddha will appear before that person, but I have been paying homage to the Buddha for more than ten years and have never had this realm appear. Maybe it's because my mind is not yet pure, there are still many distracting thoughts, or perhaps it is no longer necessary for me, because I will definitely never give up my mind to practice the religion.
When I first started believing in Buddha, I bowed my head every night to worship the sky, because at that time I thought Buddha Bodhisattva was in the sky. So, every time I hold incense, I see Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara sitting on a lotus flower in the night sky, and this sight happens every day. Then I realized that Buddha Bodhisattva appeared to strengthen my aspiration. In Buddhism, magical realms do not often appear unless it is really necessary to save people. That is also a means of saving people. I think only those
Only those who believe in Buddha must sincerely pay homage to the Buddha to see it, or there are many people who sincerely pay homage to the Buddha but do not see it, because Buddha Bodhisattva knows people's hearts. Those who are truly steadfast in their spiritual mind do not need the holy realm to appear.
The Patriarchs said: "Conquer the mind in one place, there is no problem" (Conquer the mind in one place, nothing will fail). Layperson Dieu Thanh's mind seemed to be inherently purer than ordinary people, and as soon as she saw the book "Notes on Modern Cause and Effect" she accepted it and immediately gave up all salty foods. A few days later, she told me that she had repented before Buddha about the karma she had created before and promised not to do it again.
I don't know if it can be said that she inherently does not distinguish between good and evil, inherently does not distinguish between men and women. People may call it "less thinking", but I think it is a manifestation of "egolessness". Because only when there is no "appearance of self", there is no "appearance of human beings, the appearance of sentient beings, the appearance of pseudo-appearance". Maybe she hasn't reached the final realm yet, still a mortal, will also get married, have children, sometimes get angry and scold others, also know good and evil, beautiful and ugly, but I think for her, maybe it's "when things come, deal with them", "don't be attached but give birth to your mind", "when things pass, you're empty" without attachment, so she's always happy all day. Venerable Master Hsuan Hua teaches disciples: "It's skillful to cultivate great clumsiness, but it's amazing to practice until you're stupid." Seen from this perspective, being born with "little thought" is not necessarily a bad thing. Once you hear the Dharma and believe in it, it is also "near the water to benefit".
As a Director, facing employees, she doesn't seem to know how to protect her own interests; as a woman, facing public opinion, she doesn't seem to know how to distinguish between men and women. Her mind is undefiled, generous and upright,
This cannot help but say that she is a person with great qualifications to practice religion. Even though she had just entered Buddha's door not long ago, I thought that if she could study the scriptures in depth, meditate and meditate, perhaps not long after, wisdom would appear before her eyes. When I have the chance, I will ask Venerable Dieu Phap to help her.
From a manager named Quoc who once considered money like sand, to a layperson Dieu Thanh who today can pick up and eat every grain of rice that falls to the ground, it cannot be said that it is a giant leap on the path of practice.
Through the stories and people of layperson Dieu Thanh, I seem to feel that, for a layperson, after understanding the idealistic theory of all things, on the basis of strictly maintaining precepts, if you need to eat, then eat, if you need to drink, then drink, if you need to play, then play, if you need to have fun, then have fun, if you need to communicate, then communicate, if you need to recite the Buddha, then recite the Buddha, if you need to read the sutras, then read the sutras. What has passed should be let go. Even if you don't let go, it will pass. Attachment to illusory thoughts only increases afflictions. Don't lose mindfulness, don't be attached to appearances, practice the Four Lights, benefit yourself and save others. "Moving but not moving, all day walking but never walking, all day seeing but never seeing, all day laughing but never laughing, all day hearing but never hearing, all day knowing but never knowing, all day long happy but never happy, all day doing but never acting, all day living but never staying." Such a person, whether in favorable or unfavorable circumstances (in fact, there are no adverse circumstances), is free.
Reciting Buddha's name is to stop false thoughts, not reciting Buddha to cling to the appearance of reciting Buddha. Reciting Buddha is to have Buddha in your mind, in your life, in your work, in the four majestic postures of every action, to not leave Buddha's mind is to recite Buddha. As a lay person, in addition to work, there are also many housework
must do, because those are unresolved karmas. It is possible that at all times, everything does not leave Buddha's thoughts, in order to cope with the confusing things in front of us, the mind does not change according to the scene. Is this called "non-dwelling mind"? If it is possible to create a mind without dwelling, using the Buddha mind to face everything, is that "not-self", "not-self-appearance"?
I taught layperson Dieu Thanh to sit in meditation. She only needed one movement to form the cross-legged position, not difficult at all. Teaching her the dialogue "who is the person reciting Buddha", she just closed her eyes, immediately went into the Great Hall of Nam Hoa Pagoda, said that there were many Venerable monks circumambulating Buddha reciting Buddha, then a scene appeared of the Sixth Patriarch preaching the Dharma. She thought of herself going into the Sutra Hall of Nam Hoa Pagoda to admire the relics of the Sixth Patriarch, seeing a pair of the Sixth Patriarch's socks, feeling extremely close, so she specially asked layperson Dieu An to take a photo of her with that pair of socks. She couldn't hide her pride, jokingly saying: "Previously, I was a disciple of the Sixth Patriarch, a monk. I had not cultivated well. In this life, I became a woman. Now I must cultivate well. In my next life, I must find the Sixth Patriarch to study Buddha!". Sister Dieu Dung smiled and encouraged her: "You must make vows to practice Bodhisattva, practice Buddhahood right in this life."
Is this delusion? Is Dieu Thanh really a disciple of the Sixth Patriarch from his previous life? The realm of meditation is truly inconceivable!

tieu_de: Venerable Dieu Phap Tung taught:
tom_tat: "Contemplating the mindless interior, contemplating the invisible exterior, contemplating the distance without objects, there is only emptiness of reason. But emptiness is not emptiness, all emptiness is emptiness, that is, pure and quiet. Quietness is also not, five desires are not, that is, the poetic mind...
noi_dung:
"Contemplating the mindless interior, contemplating the invisible exterior, contemplating the distance without objects, there is only emptiness of reason. But emptiness is not emptiness, all emptiness is emptiness, that is, pure and quiet. Quietness is also empty, the five desires are empty, that is, the mind of meditation, giving birth to the merit of freedom, with immeasurable wonderful uses.
