This Director does not know him and can say anything about him. Now say something that only you or somewhere else knows and see if he's right."
The other person smiled and said: "This seems so mysterious, so let's take a look at the desk drawer at my house. Only I know what's in there."
Director Ton looked into the space in front of him as if observing and asked: "The writing desk has a middle drawer with a lock, four drawers on the left without locks, the upper right drawer also without locks, and below is a cabinet door with locks. The writing desk is natural wood color, which drawer do you want me to see?"
The other person looked a bit surprised and said: "Look at the middle drawer." Director Ton immediately responded: "When opening the drawer,
There are a few notebooks, recording a number of accounts, and on the notebooks is a Japanese handheld computer. There were also several envelopes inside, and next to the envelopes were four savings books. Three books have your name written on it, one book has your son's name written on it."
When he got here, the other person's face turned red, his eyes widened, and he loudly said: "That's so magical, are you guys gods?"
The old monk smiled: "No one is a fairy, we are all mortals. But among mortals also
There are many people with certain wisdom. People should not do things that go against their conscience. After doing so, someone will know. That is also the reason why evildoers will sooner or later meet with retribution, because all of our actions and thoughts will be known by those with power, let alone Buddha Bodhisattva and demons. If you want, I can let him talk a little more, so you can get a deeper impression."
The other person was excited but also doubtful and said: "What else can I know? Tell me, today I met a fairy!"
The Venerable said to Director Ton: "He asked, please tell him how much money is in the savings book in total, and where that money comes from."
At this time, Director Ton was much more confident: "The four savings books totaled more than 17,000 yuan. Last year, your village shared profits in a fairly large but somewhat old meeting room. A person in his 40s, with a high nose and big face, gave him more than 9,000 yuan. This year, a small man with short hair gave him 6,000 yuan at home. The money was taken from a black faux leather bag, the zipper of the bag was broken, he used a small hemp rope to tie it, and a little money was from an old savings book.
The other person kept saying: "It's magical! What a miracle! Unbelievable, the first person you told was our village Secretary, the second was our captain, how did you know that?"
Director Ton also became interested and continued asking: "Have you driven a large Hoang Ha brand truck before?"
"Yes, what's wrong?"
Director Ton said: "One time I transported goods to Guangzhou. On the way back, someone in Hengyang asked me to help
drove a cart to Shijiazhuang. After unloading, they paid him 1,300 Yuan for freight. That afternoon he returned home, finished dinner and went to play cards with someone else, eventually losing more than 500 yuan. Is that true?". At this moment, I only saw the other person's mouth open, speechless.
The old Venerable smiled and said: “Don't be afraid, no one has free time to search your nooks and crannies. This is nothing new. When you get home, give up meat and fish, keep the five precepts, practice the ten virtues, and meditate for about an hour before going to bed. Silently recite 'Namo Amitabha Buddha', don't let the thought fly away, if it runs away, pull it back. During the day, when you have free time, recite Buddha's name anytime and anywhere. Be persistent and one day you will understand. Remember what I said, you should go home.” “Yes, teacher, I will be home soon.” The old Venerable looked at him and said: “I mean to tell you to return to your home of your own nature.”
I want to tell fellow practitioners that Director Ton, who suddenly had supernatural powers under the blessing of Venerable Dieu Phap, did not listen to the Venerable's instructions. He couldn't give up alcohol and meat, so his magical powers were just like a flower that blooms early in the morning and fades in the evening. After that, he came to me, but in the end he still chose wine and meat instead of magical powers. The Venerable said that in his previous lives, he was a cultivator and practiced meditation, but could not cut off desire. If you do not continue to practice in this life, in the next life you will have to fall into animal birth to pay your debt, which is a pity. I still remember these words: Do you want to have wisdom and supernatural powers? So first we must let go of mortal desires. The things that ordinary people love such as talent, beauty, fame, food, drink, sleep, if you can let go and persevere, you can achieve wisdom. Let go of desire
- Gaining wisdom, becoming a saint.
What does 'reverse' mean? It is "do good deeds for others, keep bad deeds for yourself". Get rid of the small ego, complete the big ego.
"The main purpose of cultivating the path is to attain birth and escape death, not to seek inspiration but to cultivate the path."
Really walk the path of practice, don't worry too much about whether you have supernatural powers or not. Whatever belongs to you will come to you one day without asking for it. If you don't have this mission, praying won't work. Divine powers cannot help you escape the Three Realms, nor can supernatural powers help you become a Buddha. Arhats and Bodhisattva have achieved the right results, naturally their magical powers will be free. Buddha said that after his nirvana, he would instruct Bodhisattva and Arhats to be born in this Dharma-ending age. Those who practice with great supernatural powers, as long as they eliminate desires, do not kill, do not steal, do not lie, and are not greedy, can be Bodhisattva, Arhat reincarnated. It's just that we don't recognize it with our physical eyes.
As for religious practitioners, when they have some magical powers, they consider themselves extraordinary, giving rise to arrogance, being complacent with applause and praise, gradually losing self-control, considering themselves above others. You must know that "if you lose your religion, you will receive little help", such a person is just like a flower that blooms early in the morning and withers in the evening, the end is very pitiful. In history, there have been many such painful lessons, advising such people to stop in time, only when "the eight winds do not move" can they "sit firmly on the golden lotus". Losing supernatural powers is a small matter, but falling into hell is no joke.
Old Venerable Dieu Phap once said that, if one has supernatural powers, saving sentient beings can be effective immediately; If you don't have supernatural powers but have wisdom, you can still save sentient beings.
Observing the precepts, reciting Buddha's name, chanting sutras, and keeping the mind pure, "not having evil thoughts", is also being in concentration. When you practice persistently, wisdom will naturally arise. Not only is your eloquence unobstructed, but every sentence and every word you say can correspond to the listener's mind - it can touch the listener's mind, making them listen respectfully and receive benefits. This is because you have right knowledge, right view and are blessed by Buddha's power. If you truly practice, all Buddhas Bodhisattva will definitely bless you, making your words in any situation perfect and your actions as desired.
How to cultivate wisdom? The Buddha in the Sutra teaches that: "You, monks (including all true practitioners), if you have wisdom, you will not be greedy. Often self-criticize, not making mistakes. Thus, in my dharma, liberation can be achieved. If it's not like that, then you're not a practitioner, you're not a layperson, you have no status at all. Wisdom is truly a sturdy boat that can cross the sea of suffering, old age, sickness, and death. It is also a great lamp that illuminates the darkness of ignorance. It is a good medicine for all diseases. A sharp ax to cut down the tree of afflictions. Therefore, you should listen, think and practice wisdom to grow yourself. People with wisdom, even though they do not have heavenly eyes, can still clearly see others. That's called wisdom."
"Consider yourself often, don't make mistakes" is the origin of wisdom. In the past, Zeng Tzu in China said: "I examine myself three times a day: If you work for others, is it conscientious? Communicating with friends, is it honest? Have you practiced the things that have been taught?"
Explained in modern terms, this means: Every day, I reflect three times to see if I have worked conscientiously
country and joint karma yet? Will I secretly evade taxes, causing damage to the country and business karma? In communicating with friends or in business transactions, am I being dishonest, harming the other person's interests? "Transmission not study" for Buddha disciples, this means whether they have studied and practiced according to Buddha's teachings and precepts. Regularly examine yourself to see if you have made mistakes or acted improperly. If you can do this, then that is true wisdom. This wisdom is even more precious than the heavenly eye, because this type of wisdom is not found in ghosts, demons, and ghosts, while the heavenly eye is also found in ghosts, demons, and evil spirits.
The so-called "seeing people clearly", that is, having the right view. People with wisdom, when looking at people or things, can clearly and transparently understand cause and effect and liberation methods. Therefore, the Buddha compares these practitioners to "a solid boat", "a big bright light", "a good medicine for all diseases", and "a sharp ax to cut down the tree of afflictions". Therefore, not being greedy for magical powers and cultivating wisdom is the duty of Buddha's disciples.

tieu_de: Venerable Master Hsuan Hua's SHELF:
tom_tat:
"All things are born from the Tao. People who realize themselves can understand the spirit. Understand the original nature. One can understand everything."
THE ROAD OF LIBERATION
The merit of leaving the home life is extremely great and inconceivable. In the Sutra of Praise for Sangha Merit, it is said: ...
noi_dung:
"All things are born from the Tao. People who realize themselves can understand the spirit. Understand the original nature. One can understand everything."
THE ROAD OF LIBERATION
The merit of leaving the home life is extremely great and inconceivable. In the Sutra of Praise for Sangha Merit, it is said: "Even though the Buddha's light has long gone out, the Sangha's light still continues to pass on the lamp of the Dharma; Just like the Dragon King makes sweet rain, the earth sprouts, everything is permeated. Harmony with the Sangha is the same, the rain of Tathagata's Dharma is poured down; water the parched sentient beings, nourish the seeds of merit. For many lifetimes, blessings of cultivating fields, being a disciple of Tathagata; Living in the ocean of Sage's Dharma, drinking the sweet nectar of liberation. Spread the teachings of the World-Honored One in the Dharma-ending period, transforming all ten lands; benefit all sentient beings, making the wheel of Buddha Dharma constantly rotate."
In the end of the Dharma, when people are immersed in a society full of greed and lust, the desire for money, the fire of desire burns and kills lives, living in favorable circumstances but still immersed in the mortal world, people who can truly see through, let go and leave the home life of body and mind are extremely rare.
The main character of this story is a young man, living in Shanghai, with a high level of education and no material deprivation. Since he had the opportunity to meet Buddha's teachings, he became a true believer, not deluded, and finally left the home life as a monk. How did you experience your spiritual journey? After reading it, it will definitely make us ponder deeply.
Before leaving the home life, this college karma good guy had the nickname Tieu Phi and is 24 years old this year. With a tall and tall physique
handsome, he is the only child in the family. Since childhood, Tieu Phi has had a peaceful personality and a kind heart, never comparing herself with anyone about anything. Helping others, doing good deeds are his hobbies, being a good son, loved by everyone. When he was in school, Tieu Phi liked to tell stories to his friends. Every time he told them, his inspiring voice and lively expressions made his friends excited and never tired of listening.
After graduating from university, Tieu Phi easily found a job. One day, he heard that in the Maoshan area there was a fortune teller known as a master, very good at fortune-telling and never wrong. Out of curiosity, he and his friends went there to find out. When Tieu Phi gave her date of birth, the fortune teller immediately said: “Good number, good number! Your five elements lack nothing, you will definitely be a millionaire in the future." After looking at Tieu Phi's hands, the fortune teller was even more surprised: “I can't believe it, you will definitely be a billionaire in the future! Your destiny is destined to be a rich and noble person with a bright future. Believe me, I have never looked at the wrong person."
Tieu Phi happily returned from Mao Son and began to think: "Even though my destiny is destined to be rich, money doesn't fall from the sky, I have to do something." So he started looking for ways to make money. One day, he saw the book Rich Dad Poor Dad was very popular, and he strongly agreed with the views and methods of getting rich presented in the book. Not only did he buy this entire set of books, but he also searched for more information about author Robert T. Kiyosaki online. After careful research, he firmly believes that investing is a good path to becoming rich.
He knows that investing requires capital, and to accumulate initial capital, one must have good health and energy. A healthy body is very important for success in business.
karma. Therefore, he read a lot of books about health and food nutrition. From there, he learned that modern nutritional research has discovered that nutritional ingredients from vegetarian foods are more easily absorbed by the human body than animal foods and are more beneficial to health. From an anatomical point of view, humans are inherently vegetarian animals. Human teeth are similar to the teeth of herbivores such as cows, horses, sheep and camels, all of which are flat and closely arranged, while the teeth of carnivores are often sharp and have gaps between the teeth. Furthermore, the intestines of vegetarians are 2-3 times longer than those of carnivores; Carnivores will quickly excrete meat after eating, while meat entering the human body will stay in the intestines for a long time, causing toxins and the cause of many diseases. Understanding this, Tieu Phi changed her eating habits, switching from eating meat to being mainly vegetarian. The change in diet has brought him unprecedented benefits, smooth skin, and abundant energy. At the same time, the theory of nutrition in traditional Chinese medicine also attracted Tieu Phi's great interest. He read classic medical documents such as Thoughts on Oriental Medicine, Yellow Emperor's Neural Classic, and Treatise on Typhoid.
In particular, the concept of "heaven and man unite, the spirit of internal defense" in the Yellow Emperor's Classic deeply influenced him. Traditional medical theory, with its close association with Taoism, made him passionately read the works of Lao Tzu, Chuang Tzu, and works such as the Tao Te Ching and the I Ching. These Chinese cultural works expanded Tieu Phi's horizons and stimulated his desire to learn more about the truths of the universe and life.
Due to the nature of her work, Tieu Phi often comes into contact with wealthy customers, of which there is no shortage
who owns tens of millions of assets, several villas, and many luxury cars. Gradually, they became Tieu Phi's friends, and they were also willing to share their thoughts with him. Tieu Phi realized that rich people also have their own troubles, sometimes even more miserable than ordinary people, and that money cannot bring true happiness. He thought: "I'm trying to make money, but if I become rich and be like them in the future, what meaning does life have?", Tieu Phi began to think about the future of her life.
At this time, an incident happened and changed the fate of his life.
One time, due to work, Tieu Phi went to a customer's house to pick up documents. When he rang the bell, the door opened, and Tieu Phi was stunned because the person who opened the door was a nun. During about ten minutes of chatting with the nun (because he was at work so he couldn't stay long), before saying goodbye, the nun compassionately gave him several Buddhist books, including a book of Prajna Paramita Many Heart Sutras. From then on, the treasure door of wisdom was opened to him. When he got home, he quickly told his parents about this. It could be seen that Tieu Phi was deeply shaken.
Because he did not understand the "Heart Sutra", he bought the book Explanation of the Heart Sutra with Pictures and searched online for explanations of this sutra by high monks and venerables. Through that, he discovered that there are countless Buddhist scriptures and commentaries on the internet. As if he had caught a treasure, he passionately threw himself into learning, to the point that he forgot to eat and sleep, often staying up until 3 or 4 a.m. to read books. He not only studied on his own but also regularly exchanged his study experiences with his parents. He said: "I finally know what I really need. In this world, only Buddha Dharma is the ultimate truth." Three months later, he began to completely switch to a vegetarian diet. Some young people in the company were affected
Because of him, they also started studying Buddhism, some became vegetarians and took refuge in Buddha.
Since studying Buddhism, Tieu Phi has increasingly felt the benefits of Buddha's teachings. He once said: "After studying Buddha, I no longer stopped at the surface of things, but handled problems according to Buddha's theory, dharma, knowledge and vision, the results were truly outstanding." Every day, he also takes the opportunity to travel everywhere to spread Buddha Dharma. One hot summer afternoon, at the gate of a supermarket, there was an old woman with gray hair, still wearing a thick cotton shirt, begging for food. Tieu Phi told her to wait a bit, then went back to the supermarket to buy bread and drinks for her. The old woman kept saying thank you, Tieu Phi said: "No need to thank me, just recite Amitabha Buddha!". The old woman trembled and chanted: "Amitabha Buddha!" Tieu Phi thought: "I want to plant a seed of Buddha Dharma for her. No matter how long it takes, that seed will bear fruit."
Another time, when Tieu Phi had just left the company, he met an old beggar. Without hesitation, he took out a 10 dong bill from his pocket and gave it to him. The old beggar probably didn't expect to be so lucky and was stunned for a moment. Tieu Phi smiled and said: "Recite Amitabha Buddha!". The old man stammered: "A... A... Amitabha... Da Buddha!". When Tieu Phi left, he could still hear the old man whispering: "Amitabha Buddha, Amitabha Buddha..." behind.
The progress of society, changes in the way of life, updates in the concept of time and space, and the development of material civilization have put modern people into a serious challenge. His immersion in Buddhist scriptures brought him joy and happiness. He realized that Confucianism talks about relationships between people, Taoism talks about things between heaven and earth, and Buddhism talks about the true truth of the vast universe. For the material and spiritual civilization of modern society, Buddha Dharma has practical and meaningful significance
History cannot be measured. He realized that he had the responsibility and obligation to shoulder the sacred mission of educating sentient beings and bringing peace to them. When he had the good fortune to read the Buddhist Merit Theory of Leaving the Home Life, he learned about the story of Bhikkhu Vairocana, who in just one day and one night left the home life, sowed the inconceivable conditions for liberation and finally attained enlightenment. Realizing that the merit of leaving the home life was so great, he decided to dedicate himself to leaving the home life as a monk, taking on Tathagata's career.
At that time, some relatives and friends heard that Tieu Phi wanted to leave the home life and were very surprised. Some people blame Tieu Phi's parents for letting their children be so free and not stopping them; Some people find it difficult to understand; Some people are silent, not knowing what to say; And some people praised her, saying that she didn't know from what life she was blessed to give birth to such a good child.
Tieu Phi's parents were also very surprised, they advised him: "You can also practice at home, you don't have to leave the home life". His parents also asked him: "If we were our age and had experienced many things and seen through the world, it would be easy to understand. But I'm still young, I want to step on the path of leaving the home life, can I really see through and let go of everything? Looking into the kind eyes of her parents, who had worked hard to raise her, Tieu Phi sincerely said: "I left the home life in favorable conditions, I lacked nothing, my parents even prepared a house for me. But time waits for no one, I see many people suffering, but I don't have the wisdom to help them liberate. Leaving the home life is to learn how to help them escape suffering. I want to focus completely on studying Buddha Dharma and propagating Buddha Dharma, that will be my lifelong goal." His parents did not hinder him anymore and happily agreed with his decision.
In November 2007, Tieu Phi started preparing for leaving the home life. He wanted to quit his job, but at that time there was still some unfinished work, and the unit leaders also tried to dissuade him, avoiding mentioning his resignation. Some enthusiastic customers also advised him to think carefully. But Tieu Phi was determined and patiently waited until the right opportunity came.
In December, Tieu Phi and her parents took refuge in the Three Jewels, officially becoming Buddha disciples with the Dharma name: Ban Chan.
In March 2008, Tieu Phi started practicing the diet of not eating after Horse time.
In April, Tieu Phi smoothly resigned from her job.
In May, the opportunity was ripe, Tieu Phi finally stepped on the path of leaving the home life, liberating life and death, benefiting others.
"Only when the body is clean and dusty, a person's path will be achieved!" "Congratulations, you're a real man leaving the home life
sincere heart! Try your best!"
Message: The merit of leaving the home life is hard to imagine. In the Buddha's Sutra on the merit of leaving the home life, Buddha told Ananda: If it's been a hundred years since you asked this question, I'll use infinite wisdom, except when eating and drinking to explain this person's merits to you, it won't be enough. This person is always born in heaven or among humans and becomes a king, enjoying the joy of heaven and man. If someone in this Dharma of Samana tells someone to leave the home life, or helps the cause and effect to leave the home life, then in samsara you will often enjoy joy. I say that a person's good fortune will not end for a hundred years. So, Ananda! He lived for a hundred years and asked me this, but until I entered Nirvana, I could not tell all about that person's merits.
At the end of the Dharma, if you can give up glory and wealth, see clearly, let go, leave the home life to practice, it is truly a precious and difficult thing to have. Now, Tieu Phi has become a pure monk in both body and mind. When many people saw this Bhikkhu strictly upholding the precepts and practicing diligently, they all had respect for the Three Jewels.

tieu_de: DO NOT PROPAGRATE THE HO DO THEORY
tom_tat: Ask: Many people often say that studying Buddha means you will lose karma. Chanting sutras, reciting mantras, reciting Buddha's name and worshiping,... will pour karma. Many people who have studied Buddha for a while find that everything goes wrong, illnesses, accidents, etc. When you are like...
noi_dung:
Ask: Many people often say that studying Buddha means you will lose karma. Chanting sutras, reciting mantras, reciting Buddha's name and worshiping,... will pour karma. Many people who have studied Buddha for a while find that everything goes wrong, illnesses, accidents, etc. When this happens, people often think that it's because they studied Buddha that they got this way. Then there are also many lay people sharing methods such as how to treat when karma falls,... There are also theories that say that reciting mantras Shurangama, reciting mantras Great Compassion pour out karma so the family can separate. What do you think about this issue?
Answer: This is a very wrong view of those who study Buddha Dharma, not in accordance with the Dharma.
I would like to quote a passage from the Luong Hoang Sam Sutra: “Nowhere is there a person who practices good karma, obeys Buddha's teachings, and yet suffers evil consequences, poverty, evil, disability, illness, lack of freedom, lowliness, contempt and contempt of others, whose words no one ever trusts. Now I bring my body to bear witness (author's words). If there is someone who obeys the Buddha's teachings, cultivates merits, does not selfishly harm others and suffers bad consequences, then it would be unreasonable for me to fall into Avici hell and suffer, rather than let that person who did good suffer bad consequences.
From the above sutra text, we can see that there is no such thing as practicing or studying Buddha and following Buddha's teachings without having to suffer painful consequences. If you practice and suffer the consequences of suffering, it is no different than saying Shakyamuni Buddha deceived sentient beings.
So how to explain the fact that after developing the mind to study Buddha, strictly observing the precepts, becoming vegetarian, and reciting Buddha's name, some unsatisfactory things appear in life. First of all, Buddhist students clearly understand the principle of cause and effect - karma. If you sow causes, you will have results. If you sow good causes, you will receive good results. If you sow evil causes, you will suffer painful consequences. All the suffering, injustice, or illness that each of us suffers are the results of the evil actions of Body, Speech, and Mind that we have created in the past, in previous lives or in this life. Cause and effect follows form and shadow, without any deviation. The Cause and Effect Sutra teaches: “Suppose a hundred thousand kalpas. The cause of karma is immortal. Fate meets time. The karma is completed automatically" (Suppose that in hundreds of thousands of lives, the karma created is not lost, the causes and conditions have gathered, the karma must be endured). It's all up to you, yourself. That's why when things happen when you develop the mind to observe the precepts, become a vegetarian, study Buddha, and repentance, things happen in life that don't go as expected, or get sick, those illnesses and those injustices are all the results that those people themselves have to endure because in the past they created bad karma. It's just that thanks to all Buddhas, Bodhisattva compassion blesses those people with their conversion of evil and good practice, and their development of spiritual practice, "Severe retribution becomes light retribution (Heavy retribution turns into light retribution), post-retribution becomes present retribution (Far retribution turns into near retribution)".
Aren't these very good things? Such people should be thanking all Buddhas and Bodhisattva. Heavy retribution changes to light retribution: In the past, you worked as a slaughterhouse for chickens, ducks, etc. According to cause and effect, blood debt must be paid with blood, life debt must be paid with life. If you kill, you will suffer the consequences of premature death, many diseases, or after death you will fall into the three evil paths.
But thanks to the good fortune of studying Buddha Dharma, developing the mind of repentance and turning around, giving up killing, developing the mind of vegetarianism, dedicating merit and merit to the beings who are killed and thanks to all Buddhas' compassionate blessings, instead of losing your life or falling into the three evil paths, that illness or accident will help you eliminate karma obstacles.
The Prajnaparamita Sutra teaches that: “If anyone recites these chanting sutras and is despised by others, it is because that person committed serious sins in a previous life and deserves to fall into an evil path. Today, thanks to being despised by others, the sins of previous lives have been eliminated." The Diamond Sutra also teaches: “If a person upholds the precepts and practices, constantly abandoning evil and cultivating goodness, but is despised by those around him, it is because this person, if in this life, is not close to Buddha's teachings, does not believe in Buddha, then due to the extremely bad karma of the previous life, after death, he will fall into the evil realm. Thanks to them meeting the Buddha Dharma, knowing how to practice, and strictly maintaining the precepts, karma that should have fallen into the evil realm is now being despised, humiliated, and slandered by others... which is eliminated. Therefore, those who scold them and despise them are helping them destroy their karma."
In the Story of Dharma Master Tripitaka at Dai Tu An Pagoda, it is written: “Mr. Duong Huyen Trang went to Tay Truc to request sutras, diligently practiced Buddha Dharma all his life, and wholeheartedly translated the sutras into Chinese. Towards the end of his life, he was seriously ill and lay in bed. The Guardian Angel appeared next to his bed to comfort him: “Since beginningless eons, the monk has created many evil karmas that have damaged the minds of sentient beings. Now, thanks to a little illness, the evil karmas have been eliminated. We need to be happy...". Or Master Gioi Hien, a famous and virtuous monk, became seriously ill in his old age and was tortured so painfully that he wanted to commit suicide. Then he dreamed of the three Bodhisattvas Manjushri, Samantabhadra, and Avalokiteshvara advising: “I used to be a king who caused a lot of suffering to sentient beings, so now I have to suffer this retribution. Thanks to spiritual practice, sins instead of being punished in hell are transformed into this painful illness.
Try to endure for three more years, and there will be Master Huyen Trang who will come here to request sutras and study with you. Please sincerely repentance, patiently endure suffering and diligently promote the Sutras, then your karma obstacles will naturally be eliminated. Through this, we can see that if we practice practice and get sick or have other things that are not as expected, it is just the karma that we have created in the past and is now reaping its consequences. But we must also remember that not everyone who studies Buddha will have heavy retributions become light retributions and post-retributions into present retributions. If those who study Buddha still eat meat, do not keep precepts, and do not strictly practice Buddha's teachings, then there is no way the heavy retribution will change into a light retribution.
As for sharing the treatment method when retribution comes, it is also wrong view, because there is nothing to treat. If you clearly understand the principle "instead of paying heavy karma, thanks to practice it will turn into paying lightly", then you must thank Buddha, Bodhisattva and be grateful for those difficulties and contradictions. What is necessary to do is still to maintain faith in Buddha's teachings, persistently observing the precepts strictly, fasting, chanting sutras, reciting Buddha's name, repentance... As usual, when karma is exhausted, you will no longer have to suffer that painful retribution. Because "If you endure suffering, suffering will end, if you enjoy blessings, blessings will end."
The fact that there are people or even monks in the temple who propagate that lay people should not chant the Shurangama sutras, recite the Shurangama mantras, or recite and maintain the Shurangama sutras, and the Shurangama Mantra is heavily damaged by karma, then those are all evil spirits of pagans, descendants of the Demon King. Because wherever the Shurangama Sutra exists, there is the Dharma. If the Shurangama Sutra exists, the Buddha Dharma exists. Demons, demons, and monsters are most feared in the Shurangama Sutra. That's why their children and grandchildren disguise themselves as people to propagate, so they shouldn't recite the Shurangama sutras to make it easier for them to act. During the end of the Dharma Sutra Lang
Yan will be destroyed first, that is why every Buddhist should try to study the Shurangama Sutra, reciting Shurangama mantras to protect the Dharma. And if saying that reciting Shurangama mantras requires husband and wife to separate, it is no different from saying Buddha has no compassion, he preached the Shurangama Mantra as a noose to trap sentient beings. But you must absolutely pay attention, Venerable Master Hsuan Hua has also taught many times, people reciting Shurangama mantras must absolutely observe the precepts, be vegetarian, abstain from the five spices, otherwise reciting mantras will not be effective.

tieu_de: Dharma Mon Pure Land THU THANG
tom_tat:
The story of Buddha rebirth chanting by layperson Luc Boi Lam. Layperson Luc has studied Buddha for many years, often seriously
Maintaining precepts, spending all the money saved to quietly print sutras, release animals and carry out other activities...
noi_dung:
The story of Buddha rebirth chanting by layperson Luc Boi Lam. Layperson Luc has studied Buddha for many years, often seriously
maintain the precepts, spend all the money saved to quietly print sutras, release animals and carry out other beneficial Dharma propagation activities. Under his influence, many people began to believe in Buddha and study Buddha. The true story of his father, Luc Pei Lam, from not believing in Buddha to making vows to recite Buddha's name, and finally rebirth the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss, made all the relatives and friends present there extremely shocked. After this news spread, many local people began to believe in Buddha and study Buddha.
Now, let's listen to layman Luc tell the true story of helping his father recite Buddha rebirth:
My father, Luc Pei Lam, was born on the 15th day of the 8th lunar month, 1925, in Locchi, Suzhou and in the early morning of December 25, 2006, was peacefully reborn at home.
I am the youngest child in the family, and the kindness of nurturing and caring for us from our parents is difficult to fully repay, even if our bones are broken. In the sutra it is said: "The left shoulder carries the father, the right shoulder carries the mother, walking around Tu Di mountain; Taking care of my parents, I sacrificed this whole body, the bones were crushed, the flesh was torn apart; For example, someone who, for the sake of nourishment, uses his own hands to pierce your river; For example, if someone took a very sharp knife, cut open his stomach, pulled out all his heart and soul, spilling blood all over the earth without complaining, after hundreds of thousands of lifetimes, he still could not repay the deep kindness of his parents.
Therefore, if you want to be filial to your parents, you must not simply give them good food and beautiful clothes, but also help them study.
Practicing the Buddha Dharma, rebirthing the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss, can repay the gratitude as deep as the ocean, the nurturing gratitude of our parents. In 1995, when I was working in Shanghai, I heard about the Buddha Dharma, and especially had an affinity with the Pure Land Dharma. I deeply believed that this was a rare karma from countless lifetimes. A difficult human life has now been obtained, the Buddha Dharma is difficult to hear, and now I have heard it. I must definitely advise my family to study Buddha and pray for Pure Land.
I started advising my family to study Buddhism, but because I didn't know how to be tactful, I asked my family to study Buddhism to be vegetarian. Hearing that studying Buddhism requires vegetarianism, no one in my family is willing to study anymore. My father especially objected, he said: "In the past, we didn't have the opportunity to eat meat. Now we have the opportunity to eat meat without feeding it. People live in this world to eat a little better." After that, I advised my family not to kill and only eat the three pure flesh.
In 1998, I started becoming a vegetarian. At that time, my family strongly opposed it, saying that vegetarianism was not nutritious and unhealthy, and advised me not to become a vegetarian. I told my family that cows, horses, and elephants all eat grass but are very strong. Human teeth are flat, God originally arranged for humans to be vegetarians, and carnivores' teeth are sharp. I said the word "humiliation" (肉) in Chinese is a symbol of wisdom, what does it mean? A person opens his mouth to eat another person, that is the word "humiliation". This means: eating meat is people eating people. The word human below refers to animals, chickens, fish, pigs, etc., all of which are reincarnated humans. When the dead person is reincarnated as an animal, the animal runs out of karma and is reincarnated as a human, changing positions to eat each other, you eat me, I eat you, injustice and retribution, never ending. I advise the family to eat one vegetarian meal, which is equivalent to releasing animals once. If they can eat vegetarian for one day, then on that day the above killings will occur.
This world has nothing to do with us. After two years of being a vegetarian, my family saw that I was very healthy, my face was better than before, my wife also started being a vegetarian and studying Buddhism. From then on, when I advised my family to study Buddhism, they gradually accepted it.
My mother saw that my husband and I studied Buddhism, became vegetarians, and were in very good spirits, so she also started studying Buddhism and became vegetarians. My brother and my two sisters also fast for six days, but my father still cannot accept vegetarianism. He usually likes to play mahjong, only occasionally chanting Buddha's name. Time passed, year after year, my heart was extremely worried, my father was 79 years old, I blamed myself for not studying Buddha well, not being able to impress him. I tried every way to advise my father to study Buddhism.
One time, I talked to my father about why people need to study Buddha? What is the purpose of studying Buddha? I told my father: "We study Buddha to understand the truth of the universe and human life, to escape the ocean of suffering of samsara. The Mahaparinirvana Sutra says that all sentient beings have Buddha nature, every sentient being can become a Buddha. Human life is short and impermanent. After death, even though the body is no longer there, the spirit consciousness (ie the eighth consciousness) does not die, it is only exchanged for another body, just like when our clothes are old or torn, we replace them with new ones, just like the house we live in, when the house is broken, we change it to a new one, but the owner of the house remains unchanged. Studying Buddha is transforming the eighth consciousness into the four wisdoms, restoring our original appearance, that is, becoming Buddha. Giving up the old body to get a new one does not make us afraid of birth and death, but what is scary is not knowing where we will be reborn after death, this is very important.
My father asked: "After death, where do people go?". I said: "After death, people depend on their karma
can go to six places, that is, six realms of samsara". My father asked: "What are those six realms?". I said: "The first is the heaven realm, the second is the human realm, the third is the asura realm, the fourth is the animal realm, the fifth is the hungry ghost realm, and the sixth is the hell realm. Later I will explain more clearly about these six realms. But these six realms are not where we should go, our real home is the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss, our real parent is Amitabha Buddha. We study Buddha to become Buddha, to be able to go to the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss, to this university to achieve success, and then to return to save our parents for many generations, many lifetimes and sentient beings who are suffering."
My father asked: "Is it okay to study Buddha just by reciting 'Namo Amitabha Buddha'?". I said: "Dad is old and illiterate. Just chant 'Namo Amitabha Buddha' and you'll be fine. When we're young, we can also recite Namo Amitabha Buddha." My father asked: "Why should we recite 'Namo Amitabha Buddha'?". I said: "Because the Original Teacher Shakyamuni Buddha Buddha and all Buddhas of the ten directions advise us to recite Amitabha Buddha, Bodhisattva Manjushri, Bodhisattva Samantabhadra are great Bodhisattva, Fully Enlightened Bodhisattva in the world of Flower Store, also making vows to recite Amitabha Buddha to reach the Western Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss".
My father asked again: "What does 'Namo Amitabha Buddha' mean? Why is it so important?". I told my father: "Buddha dharma passed from India, 'Namo Amitabha Buddha', in which the two words 'Namo' when translated into Chinese mean refuge, refuge, respect; The letter 'A' translates as nothingness, 'Amitabha' translates as quantity, 'Buddha' translates as enlightenment, wisdom, or light, feeling. 'Namo Amitabha Buddha' means taking refuge in immeasurable light, taking refuge in immeasurable life. Amitabha Buddha is the most noble aura, the king among the Buddhas. Amitabha Buddha's title has inconceivable merit. Bhikkhu Phap Tang practiced countless lives to achieve this holy title. Amitabha Buddha generated forty-eight elements
vow to save all sentient beings equally and unconditionally, including the eighteenth vow which is the vow of ten recitations for all birth: "When I become a Buddha, if sentient beings in the ten directions hear my name, believe and rejoice, all their good roots dedicating merit seek birth in my land, even for just ten thoughts. If they are not born, I swear I will not become a Buddha, except for those who commit the five transgressions and slander the Dharma." The eighteenth vow, Amitabha Buddha tells us that, at the time of death, if we use a sincere mind and recite the ten Buddha sentences named Namo Amitabha Buddha, Amitabha Buddha will come and lead us to the world of Ultimate Bliss. Amitabha Buddha's conditions are very low, lower than all the conditions of all Buddhas in the ten directions, anyone can do it. Therefore, the Original Teacher Shakyamuni Buddha Buddha and all Buddhas of the ten directions advise us to recite Namo Amitabha Buddha, but we must not have a mind of chance and wait until the moment of death to recite Amitabha Buddha, this is not possible. Normally, we do not recite Buddha's name, and when we die, we cannot recite Buddha's name. Amitabha Buddha made forty-eight great vows, every vow is for sentient beings."
I showed the picture of Amitabha Buddha to my father: "The great and compassionate Amitabha Buddha is raising his hand to beckon us, waiting for us to return home. We are lost children who have wandered countless lives, still not wanting to return home. Although Amitabha Buddha is very compassionate, if the children do not want to return, the parents cannot do anything. We recite Namo Amitabha Buddha, which means telling our parents that we want to return home, asking them to come and take us back home. We want to go to the world of Ultimate Bliss, Amitabha Buddha will definitely come to lead us."
After I discussed with my father, he understood why it was necessary to study Buddha, why it was necessary to recite "Namo Amitabha Buddha".
My father asked: "The person who is reborn to the realm of Ultimate Bliss, has never seen or heard of it before." I immediately took that opportunity to tell my father about rebirth: “Dad, I will tell you a story about rebirth: During the Tang Dynasty, there was a person who specialized in killing cows for a living named Truong Thien Hoa. During his life, he killed many cows. When he was about to die, he saw many headless cows surrounding him, demanding his life. Truong Thien Hoa was so scared that he called for help. Fortunately, a monk passed by, heard the cry for help from inside the house, immediately rushed in and asked why he was calling for help. He said he saw many headless cows wanting to take his life. He said that perhaps those were the cows he had killed in this life. The monk said that it was the karma of killing. Then, the Venerable burned an incense stick and gave it to Truong Thien Hoa, telling him to recite Namo Amitabha Buddha immediately. Truong Thien Hoa tried to chant Amitabha Buddha, after about ten minutes, the headless cows disappeared. He continued to recite Namo Amitabha Buddha, and after reciting less than ten Buddha's name, Amitabha Buddha came to take him to the realm of Ultimate Bliss. Because you recited Buddha with the most sincere mind. If you just recite without a sincere mind, it will not be effective."
After hearing this story, my father had even more faith and asked to take refuge in the Three Jewels. Venerable Dat Duyen passed on the Three Refuges to my parents, and Master reminded my parents very sincerely: “You must see clearly, let go, endure suffering and liberate suffering, sincerely recite Buddha, recite Buddha to become Buddha.”
My father used to love playing mahjong, but after taking refuge, he gave up this bad habit. He started fasting on the first and full moon days of every month, and on the remaining days he ate three pure meats. Then when I came home from Shanghai, I often
Tell your family and neighbors stories about Buddhism, everyone loves to hear them. I also often bring VCDs explaining the Ten Virtuous Karma Sutras, the Ksitigarbha Sutra and the Infinite Life Sutra for my family and neighbors to watch. I asked my father: "Dad, do you understand when you listen to the sutra?". My father said: “Every day, listen to the sutra for five hours and recite Buddha's name for one hour. First, you must understand the principles. After listening to the Ten Virtuous Karma Sutras and the Ksitigarbha Sutra, my father understood that goodness cannot be practiced without practice, and evil cannot be stopped. After that, every month I keep ten days of fasting." After listening to the sutra, my father also explained the principles he understood to other elders, and asked me to bring more scriptures, beads, and VCDs of the sutra teachings for him to give to others, and to give to the elderly's living room to form relationships with everyone. He said that so that everyone can hear Buddha's teachings, study Buddha well, life has direction and goals.
My father has been listening to the sutra for more than two years. He has a new perception and understanding of the Saha world, the evil world of the five defilements and the solemnity of the right retribution and robe of the world of Ultimate Bliss, as well as the six paths of samsara. One time my father had a cold and felt very tired listening to the sutras for five hours a day, but he still persevered in listening to the Dharma. There was a time when he coughed very badly and had blood mixed in his phlegm, but his parents didn't tell us. One time I called home and heard my father coughing a lot, so I asked: “Dad, are you not well?”. My father said: "Maybe you have a cold, a little tired, it's okay." After that, he reduced the time spent listening to the sutras to two hours. I am an ungrateful child, I only go home to visit my parents once every three weeks. This time I came home earlier and saw that my father's body had become thinner and his phlegm was mixed with blood. I knew that bloody sputum was a bad sign, so I immediately went with my brother to take my father to the doctor. Examination results showed that my father had lung cancer, and it was in the middle to late stages.
It was reported on June 28. My family and I did not tell the truth about my father's illness, only saying that he had tuberculosis. I said: "Dad, right now it's best for you to become a vegetarian, focus on reciting Buddha, temporarily stop listening to the sutras, and listen to them again when your body is better." My father agreed. My family and I discussed and decided not to let my father undergo chemotherapy, because he is old, chemotherapy only increases his pain without any benefit.
I told my father: "If you recite Buddha's name, you should learn from the method of reciting Dharma Master De Nhan's disciple. When reciting when you are tired, rest. After resting, you will feel better and then reciting again. Reciting must start from the heart and your ears must hear clearly." A fellow practitioner gave my father a Buddha recitation machine with six syllables and five syllables and showed him how to breathe while reciting Buddha with five syllables. Naturally inhale and exhale, chanting Buddha very gently. My father really likes this way of chanting. He says it's not tiring and helps calm the mind more than before. He kept the Buddha chanting machine running for 24 hours, waking up in the middle of the night and chanting Buddha. During my father's illness, he continued to release animals, I also continuously released animals on his behalf and knelt down chanting the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutras, dedicating merit to father's unjust bondholders, printing 30,000 copies of the Amitabha Sutra, 5,000 copies of the Ksitigarbha Sutra, 15,000 paintings of the Western Three Saints, 5,000 paintings of Ksitigarbha. Bodhisattva, dedicating merit to his father and his unjust bondholders, hoping that he can turn heavy retribution into light retribution, post-retribution into present retribution.
Even though my father had lung cancer, he was not in pain, he just felt that he did not have much strength, his body became increasingly weak, and then gradually lost his strength. My two older sisters advised my father to eat meat, thinking that it would supplement his nutrition. But my father was determined not to eat, he said: “This disease is the result of killing and eating meat. This is the present karma obstacle. Being vegetarian is a vow that has been made, no matter what the body is like.
Don't eat meat anymore." I knelt before the Buddha statue and prayed to Amitabha Buddha: “If my father is still alive, please let him get better day by day; If you no longer have a lifespan, please compassionate Amitabha Buddha come and take care of you soon."
On the afternoon of November 22, father could not walk and could only lie on the bed and recite Buddha's name. Hearing the news, I immediately returned home and saw my father giving him intravenous fluids, still chanting Buddha. I asked: “Are you in pain, Dad?” He replied: "No pain, just no strength." I knew my father's time was running out, so I asked: “Have you made your rebirth vows about Ultimate Bliss yet?”. He said: “No, just making vows to be a vegetarian.” I said: “This great vow must be made. If you don't make vows, no matter how diligently you recite Buddha's name, you will not be able to rebirth, because to rebirth Ultimate Bliss, three conditions must be met: Faith, Prayer, Happiness. Father is currently lacking in wishes. Master Random Ich said: If you don't make vows to rebirth Ultimate Bliss, even if you recite Buddha's name to the point where the wall is made of copper or iron, the wind doesn't blow it down, the rain doesn't wet it, you can't rebirth. If you make a vow to be reborn in Ultimate Bliss, then at the time of death, even with just ten thoughts, one thought can still be reborn. The quality of rebirth depends on the depth or shallowness of your recitation of Buddha." My father said: “Is making vows so important, now I'm making vows rebirth Ultimate Bliss”. I said: “Father, please follow me making vows: Disciple Luc Boi Lam wholeheartedly surrenders his life to the Ultimate Bliss world of Amitabha Buddha...". Just like that, I said one sentence, he said another sentence, he made vows on his hospital bed.
After making vows, my father asked: “When will Amitabha Buddha come to take me to Ultimate Bliss?”. I said: “Don't be in a hurry, father, concentrate on reciting Buddha, when the time comes, Amitabha Buddha will definitely come to guide you. Chanting Buddha's name is like making a wireless phone call with Amitabha Buddha. Chanting continuously is like talking to Amitabha Buddha. Amitabha Buddha has
With great supernatural powers, he is now by my side." My father nodded and said: “I understand.” After speaking, immediately chant Buddha. When relatives came to visit, his father immediately avoided them, did not talk to the family, only asked the family to welcome him on his behalf. Dad's rest time is only eating and sleeping. Every time he finished a meal, as soon as he put down his chopsticks, he recited Buddha's name. Even when we were concerned and asked questions, he told us not to talk to him. Because he knew that there was not much time left, life and death were important, life was impermanence, he wanted to seize the remaining time to practice diligently, without being disturbed. Father's practice was like a retreat, sincere and diligent, touching the whole family. The fellow practitioners saw him reciting Buddha's name and complained that they were not as good. Day after day, he was not lazy or indolent, and I told my father the truth about his illness. “Dad, you have lung cancer,” and advised him: "If people are born, they must die. It is inherently impermanence. Sooner or later, we will have to walk on this path. We will definitely face death. No one can avoid it." My father said: "I'm not afraid, I've seen through and let go of everything, I know everything." Father taught me and my family: “Studying Buddha must be followed by teachings, don't consider studying Buddha as knowledge, don't think that you still have tomorrow, death is still far away, thinking about life and death must be urgent. I listened to the sutra but did not fully understand this principle. It was only thanks to having cancer that I realized that it is like being sentenced to death, you can die at any time. If you do not concentrate on reciting Buddha and pray for Ultimate Bliss, you will definitely fall into the three evil paths. In this life, you must rebirth Ultimate Bliss no matter what." Having finished speaking, he continued to chant Buddha.
At 2:35 a.m. on December 22, my father told the whole family: "Dad is about to return to Ultimate Bliss", and called his grandchildren and great-grandchildren home to meet one last time. He also removed the IV needle himself and did not want to eat anymore, so he asked to be transferred immediately
my brother's house. In the countryside, there is a custom that when parents die, they must stay at their eldest son's house. We arranged for Dad to rest in peace, and the whole family came together to support the chanting. I also invited lay people from Buddhism and lay forestry in the Ngo Trung area to help chant Buddha on behalf of the singer. Because my father likes to recite Buddha in the six-syllable, five-syllable tone, we also recite Buddha that way. When assisting in chanting, we are not attached to reciting four words or six words, nor are we fixed on the tone, we just need to follow the wishes of the person about to be reborn.
While helping my father chant, I realized something that I want to share for everyone's reference: When reciting Buddha to see off someone's rebirth, you should not recite it quickly. Healthy people like us who chant Buddha quickly also take a lot of effort, while the person assisting in chanting can change shifts to rest, but people who are about to rebirth chant Buddha non-stop. If they recite Buddha quickly, they cannot keep up, they may not even be able to breathe, or they may develop mental afflictions, which will hinder their rebirth. When assisting in chanting, we need to imagine that we are the one doing the rebirth, that someone else is helping us chant. We must use a sincere and grateful heart to help the chanter, so we can sympathize with the person about to rebirth. Helping others is also helping yourself, you need to know that helping others rebirth to the world of Ultimate Bliss is also creating conditions for yourself. If the person about to rebirth does not want to recite the Buddha's name, or says words contrary to the rebirth wish, or wants to eat or drink, or falls into a coma, then it is necessary to continuously teach them: "Let go of all conditions, single-mindedly think of Buddha". In addition, people should also arrange to read the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra to dedicating merit to their unjust bondholders, helping the unjust bondholders leave them. Here is my advice.
I saw that my father could keep up with Buddha's chanting, his breathing rate also matched the frequency of the Buddha's chanting tone. Although the voice
His Buddha chant was very light, but he still kept chanting. My brother, sister and I all knelt next to our father and recited Buddha's name, not leaving his side. We supported the chanting for a whole day and a night.
During the recitation, my brother and I reminded our father every twenty minutes: "Let go of everything, single-mindedly think of Buddha". We advise you to grit your teeth and overcome this challenge, wait for Amitabha Buddha to come and guide you before leaving, and when leaving, export your soul from the top of your head. When Buddha and Bodhisattva come, clasp your hands to welcome them and leave with a smile. My father all agreed.
At about 10 a.m. on December 24, Father raised his hand and pointed toward the Buddha statue of the Western Buddha. I asked: "Dad, what do you see?". Father replied that he saw many Bodhisattva, Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva also came. I said: "I must wait for Amitabha Buddha to come and take me before I can go." Father nodded. After another hour, father raised his hand again and said: "Amitabha Buddha has arrived". Hearing that, my heart was filled with joy. After that, my father raised his hand a few times, always with a smile on his face, clear eyes, clear mind, no signs of affliction, wholeheartedly chanting Buddha's name. At 9 p.m., Father looked at the lay people who were helping with the chanting with eyes full of gratitude. The lay people told him: "With Buddha in mind, please go first with Amitabha Buddha to the world of Ultimate Bliss. Later, come with Amitabha Buddha to welcome us." Father nodded and said to my mother: "I'm going ahead with Amitabha Buddha, please chant Buddha well, don't be sad, I'm not about to die, but about the Ultimate Bliss of the world to become Buddha." I said: "Father, you did not return to the world of Ultimate Bliss to enjoy happiness. You must make a vow to come back again, like Amitabha Buddha to save sentient beings." Father nodded and said: "I will definitely come back. I want to repay Buddha's gratitude and gratitude to sentient beings." Having finished speaking, father continued to recite Buddha's name.
At 1:35 a.m. on December 25, Father raised his right hand. At this time he had no strength left. Layman Cao immediately knelt down to support his father's hand, calling everyone to kneel down and recite Buddha's name. I closed my eyes and chanted Buddha, and saw four types of Buddha light, blue, yellow, red, and white, flashing before my eyes.
At 1:48 a.m. on December 25, he was very at ease with a smile on his face. In the "A" of the chant "Amitabha Buddha," he was peacefully reborn.
All Buddhas in three generations did not lie. When my father was dying, he still maintained mindfulness and was guided by the Buddha, which proved the sutra in the Buddha's Teaching Amitabha Sutra: "If there is a good man or good woman who hears about Amitabha Buddha, believes with all his heart, recites the Buddha's name for one day, two days, three days, four days, five days, six days up to seven days, with one mind undisturbed, then when this person is about to die, Amitabha Buddha and the Saints will appear before him. When this person passes away, the mind does not go crazy and is reborn into the realm of Ultimate Bliss of Amitabha Buddha." The great layman saw Amitabha Buddha handing over the lotus throne to Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva to lead my father. Many lay people also see the Three Saints of the West, some even hear music from the heavenly world, the fragrant aroma spreads, making people feel pure and peaceful in body and mind. At that time, the chanting of Buddha reached its climax, my heart was filled with Dharma joy, my body and mind became pure and peaceful, a feeling that is difficult to describe in words. The lay people were very compassionate, not sleeping for two days and two nights and persistently supporting the chanting. The layman Cao said that this chanting was especially wonderful, he had never experienced anything like this.
From December 22 until the coffin is taken for cremation, chanting continues for 24 hours without interruption, making the atmosphere in the shrine become especially peaceful and warm.
pressure. The lay people who assisted in the recitation as well as the neighbors and relatives who came to help did not feel like they were in a spiritual temple but like they were attending a Buddha retreat, which was truly remarkable. Before the cremation day, at noon, the weather was sunny and suddenly there was a small rain that lasted about ten minutes. Many old people say that in winter, the weather is sunny but rain is rare. People who study Buddhism understand that it is nectar falling from the sky!
On the morning of the funeral, Master Qua Khanh and layperson Tham also came very early to help pray and see my father off. They represented lay people and initiates who were unable to attend, sending fresh wreaths and offerings. I was moved to tears. Master Qua Khanh saw my father's rosy face, bright skin, and soft body, and immediately said: "You have freely reborn, it is thanks to your good roots, merits and blessings and karma that have ripened for countless lifetimes. The recitation of Buddha is the cause, the rebirth of Ultimate Bliss in the world is the effect. Everyone admires him! You must definitely be willing to return." Suddenly, teacher Qua Khanh heard laughter ringing in his ears and he said: "He still shows laughter, it's truly inconceivable."
When the coffin was taken away, about 100 people came to see him off. The lay people all wore blue ao dai, the group was very solemn. I held the statue of the Western Three Saints at the head of the group, hoping that everyone would have an affinity with the Buddha. When the villagers saw it, they respected it and said: "People who study Buddha are really good." That day was a beautiful sunny day. When we arrived at the farewell room at Lang Nghiem Son cemetery, everyone recited Buddha's name with full joy. Before cremation, we arranged for father to sit cross-legged in a meditation position for cremation. Even though my father passed away for three days and three nights, his body was still soft. Many lay people and relatives who have not studied Buddha saw it and said it was true
so miraculous, unimaginable, this once again increases everyone's belief in Buddha. My mother told me: "My father and I have created a lot of evil karma all our lives. Actually, just being vegetarian and reciting Buddha's name for six months can still rebirth the world of Ultimate Bliss. It's unbelievable!". I replied: "It is thanks to the great aspiration of Amitabha Buddha that karma rebirth is possible. The Buddhist method of reciting only requires three elements "faith, vow, practice", no doubt, no interference, no interruption, ten thousand people practice, ten thousand witnesses, Amitabha Buddha with great compassion guides all sentient beings equally. After cremation, we collected flower relics, which were white, green and yellow. The crematorium said: "Your father practiced reciting the Buddha's name in such a short time and was able to have relics and flowers. It is truly Buddha's blessing."
Amitabha Buddha, I would like to end my article here. I would like to express my deep gratitude and immense gratitude to all the great virtues, intellectuals and fellow practitioners who have helped my father, Luc Boi Lam.
Comment from layperson Qua Khanh: In today's society, "many people recite Buddha's name, few rebirth people". So why did layman Luc's father, even though he only started making vows to fast and recite Buddha's name for half a year before his death, was able to safely rebirth Ultimate Bliss Pure Land? There are three main reasons:
Lay people study Buddha diligently, always save money to give away material things, and print Mahayana scriptures to benefit sentient beings. Furthermore, Luc lay people have grave unfilial transgression, a wish for their parents to leave suffering and be happy, liberated and become Buddha. During his father's illness, layman Luc knelt down to read the Lotus Sutra of the Wonderful Dharma, at the same time printed scriptures and released animals to dedicating merit to his father and the unjust bondholders, helping to accumulate personal salary for his father's rebirth.
Layman Luc's father practiced "faith and vows", deeply believed in cause and effect, completely cut off salty foods, made vows in this life to definitely rebirth Ultimate Bliss Pure Land, then return to save sentient beings. Every day, he persistently recited Buddha's name sincerely and regularly, and at the same time listened to the disc lectures of the great monks to eliminate delusions and strengthen his belief in Buddha's teachings.
When he was about to die, the family chanted Buddha's name for him, invited lay people to help, the family did not cry, did not kill, and held a funeral according to the dharma. This also became a favorable condition to help layman Luc's father have a smooth rebirth. Children can help their parents rebirth in the West to show true filial piety.

tieu_de: PEOPLE'S BENEFIT IS YOUR BENEFIT
tom_tat: In the early days of my career, I always wanted to do something that truly benefited others, but because greed, anger, ignorance, pride and selfishness prevailed, this was delayed for a long time...
noi_dung:
In the early days of my career, I always wanted to do something that would truly benefit others, but because greed, anger, ignorance, pride and selfishness prevailed, this was delayed for a long time. Until 5 years later, one day, I decided to quit my job at the government agency and start pursuing a career in traditional medicine. I was determined to complete this completely. So I went to the city's Charity Foundation, and this special experience completely changed my perspective on life.
The staff of the Charity Fund enthusiastically introduced many children in need of help. Among a pile of documents about poor children, there was a photo of a little girl that deeply attracted me. The little girl with a face full of self-pity, with eyes filled with tears, below the photo is an introduction about her family's situation, writing: "The girl's name is Thai Linh Linh, Thai Linh Linh's father, since January 2000, has been bedridden due to serious kidney disease, both kidneys are completely damaged, has now had a kidney transplant surgery, medical expenses are about 200,000 Yuan, is still in the stage of drug treatment, every month needs thousands of Yuan for medical expenses, her child's tuition is lacking, her family life is poor, looking forward to receiving your help. help from kind hearts".
On the back of the document, little girl Thai Linh Linh, about to enter second grade, expressed her wishes: "Because my father is sick, family conditions are very difficult. Please kindly help me. I will try to pass the university entrance exam and become a student."
Good doctors help many patients be healthy, cheerful and happy."
The next day, after completing the scholarship support procedures, I called Linh Linh's house. The person on the phone was Linh Linh's father. He spoke in a weak and quiet voice about his illness. The doctor announced that he had a "death sentence", could only live another year, and now lies in bed every day waiting for the day his life ends. During the phone call, I encouraged Linh Linh's father that he must try to overcome it. A man who has just turned 30 should strive to do something useful. As long as he does not self-destruct, I believe that he will definitely overcome this difficulty. From today, you must be determined to give up all types of meat, become a vegetarian, recite the Buddha name "Namo Amitabha Buddha" dedicating merit to all sentient beings that you have ever hurt, and repentance the evil karma that you have caused before. Don't lie in bed all day, get up and do some light exercise.
Three months later, I called Linh Linh's father again. The voice on the other end of the line became strong and excited: "Thank you very much indeed, Buddha's teachings are really good. Now I have slowly recovered some strength, can do some chores around the house, and no longer worry my family...". To further strengthen Father Linh Linh's faith, in addition to periodically writing letters to encourage him to overcome his illness, I also sent books such as Notes on modern cause and effect, Stories about killing and releasing animals, Benefits of vegetarianism and Buddha recitation, hoping he can truly understand the cause and effect principle to better study Buddha's teachings.
Up to now, more than five years have passed, and Linh Linh's father's health condition has stabilized. Every day, he persistently ate
vegetarian, study Buddha, chant the name "Namo Amitabha Buddha" and can recite the Great Compassion Mantra by heart, chanting from 5 to 21 times a day. In a letter to me, he said that he had found a stable job that, although the income was not high, could still support his family, so he hoped that I would no longer need to continue supporting his daughter Linh Linh, but instead spend this money to help more difficult families. Linh Linh also passed the entrance exam to the district's key high school with excellent results, becoming an excellent high school student. The whole family lives happily and in harmony.
A person who was once told by the hospital that he could only live a year at most, to be able to live until today, is truly a miracle! Buddha Dharma is truly a wonderful Dharma. I thank the power of Buddha Dharma!
This experience taught me many things: Before, I did not know how to appreciate blessings, spent money lavishly, liked to wear branded clothes, eat exquisite foods, buy high-end items, and only cared about my own material enjoyment. Now that I think back, I'm really embarrassed. If I use this money properly and economically, I can help some difficult families solve their life problems. Instead of beautifying yourself, it's better to use your daily savings to give to sentient beings who need help, so not only will the person receiving help feel happy, but you yourself will also be happy from the bottom of your heart.
A fake location once said: “All joy in the world comes from helping others, and all suffering in the world comes from self-interest.” In fact, only when benefiting others can you truly benefit yourself. Coming here, I understand the value of life, clearly define my goals, and feel complete in my heart.
never had before. The joy that this completeness brings cannot be measured with money, nor can it be expressed with words. Like a person who drinks water and knows whether it's cold or warm, those who are destined to read these lines should not hesitate anymore, directly feel the joy of benefiting others through practice!

tieu_de: DISCIPLINE of the Three Jewels THAI VI
tom_tat: Comments: Trong Kinh Đại Bát Niết Bàn - quyển hai mươi lăm - “Phẩm Quang Minh Biến Chiếu Cao Quý Đức Vương Bồ Tát thứ mười" có dạy rằng: “If you leave the four dharmas and achieve Nirvana, that is impossible. What are those four dharmas? ...
noi_dung:
Comments: Trong Kinh Đại Bát Niết Bàn - quyển hai mươi lăm - “Phẩm Quang Minh Biến Chiếu Cao Quý Đức Vương Bồ Tát thứ mười" có dạy rằng: “If you leave the four dharmas and achieve Nirvana, that is impossible. What are those four dharmas? The first is to stay close to good friends. Second, concentrate on listening to the Dharma. Third is thinking clearly. Fourth is practicing the Dharma correctly. Good man, for example, there is a person who has many diseases, heat and cold, tuberculosis, hypothermia, and many evil spirits and poisons. They went to see the doctor. The physician immediately followed the patient and gave him medicine. This person sincerely accepted the doctor's teachings. According to the instructions, take the medicine and take it according to the law. After drinking it, the illness is gone and the body is at peace."
Linh Linh's father was helped by good knowledge to get close to the Buddha Dharma, from which he turned from danger to peace, this once again proves that the Buddha Dharma is the king of the Medicine Kings. All sentient beings, all kinds of diseases, when they are close to the Buddha Dharma and correct their mistakes, can change their destiny, turn to good and avoid evil. Benefiting others is benefiting yourself, harming others is harming yourself, this is the law of cause and effect that cannot be changed. Every Buddha disciple should develop Bodhi mind, use wisdom Buddha Dharma to help all sentient beings, only then can they themselves achieve the Buddha path. May all those who are destined to practice practice together.

tieu_de: PRACTICE gives NON-THAN
tom_tat: Giving is the first of the Six Dharmas and is the inevitable path to accumulate merit and reach Buddhahood. The Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra teaches: "In the future, if there are kings and brahmins, when they see these people...
noi_dung:
Giving is the first of the Six Dharmas and is the inevitable path to accumulate merit and reach Buddhahood. The Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra teaches: "In the future, if there are kings and Brahmins who, when they see old people, sick people, or women giving birth, in a single thought arise great compassion, giving medicine, food, and resting place, to help them be happy, then these precious blessings are truly inconceivable. For one hundred kalpas, he often became the king of the pure heaven, for two hundred kalpas he often became the king of the six heavens of desire, and finally became a Buddha, never falling into evil paths, for hundreds of thousands of kalpas, his ears did not hear the sound of suffering.
During the snowstorm in early 2008, China Central Television broadcast a news report: In Chongqing city, a pregnant woman walked alone to a nearby hospital for a routine health check-up. As she approached the sidewalk, she suddenly felt severe stomach pain and couldn't stand. Passersby saw this, some called the 120 emergency center, some called a taxi, and some called the radio station to ask for help. At this time, the pregnant woman could no longer bear the pain, half sitting and half lying on the side of the road. Not long after, ambulance 120 arrived, the doctor checked her condition and decided to let her give birth on the spot. Any delay would endanger the lives of mother and child. At that time, a taxi passed by, the female driver immediately stopped the car, ran towards the crowd, saw the woman giving birth, without saying a word, she took off her coat, spread it under the woman's back, until the woman gave birth safely, the blood soaked the shirt. After that, the female driver quietly drove away.
Even though this female driver is not necessarily a Buddha disciple, nor does she necessarily understand the merit of giving, her compassion comes from her heart, her selfless giving to a woman giving birth is an act of great compassion that each of us Buddha disciples should learn. This type of formless giving, as said in the sutra: "This precious blessing is truly inconceivable. For one hundred lifetimes, he will always be the king of the pure heaven, for two hundred lifetimes, he will be the king of the six heavens of desire, and ultimately become a Buddha, forever not falling into the evil realms. For hundreds of thousands of lifetimes, his ears will not hear the sound of suffering."
giving can be divided into two types: Giving has form and giving has no form. Giving has the form of giving with the mind hoping for retribution, attached to the difference between the giver and the recipient, so it is also called worldly giving. Because it is giving, there will naturally be blessings in the future, but because we have a mind that hopes for retribution, we only receive blessings from natural and organic beings. When the blessings run out, we fall into the samsara circle, so it is not the ultimate giving. Giving without form is the opposite of giving with form. When giving, the giver realizes that the giver, the receiver and the giving object are all inherently empty, not attached to anything. Because it can overcome the afflictions of the world, it is called giving beyond the world. Because these three things are like wheels and can crush all afflictions and obstacles, they are also called the "Three Wheels of Emptiness". Only giving "Three Wheel Emptiness" can help us cross the sea of birth and death, reaching the shore of liberation Nirvana, therefore it is called "giving Paramita". As it says in the Diamond Sutra: “Bodhisattva should give without attachment to appearances. That means not relying on form to give, not relying on sound, smell, taste, touch, or dharma to give. Practicing Bodhi, Bodhisattva should give like that, not relying on form. Why? Because if Bodhisattva does not rely on the form that gives, then those merits and blessings are inconceivable... Without the appearance of self, the appearance of oneself, the appearance of sentient beings, and the appearance of a recipient, cultivating all good dharmas will immediately attain Anuttara Sammyak Sambodhi. This is the highest realm of compassion in life.
Thinking back to when I was a teenager, once sitting on the back of my father's bicycle, suddenly an unprecedented feeling of pleasure spread from my lower region. From then on, to pursue this special feeling, I started masturbating. Gradually, when I went to school, I was always daydreaming, couldn't concentrate, thought about things I shouldn't think about, and my academic results dropped from top to average. My appearance became more and more ugly. By the time I was in high school, my weight had reached 70 kg. My appearance could be described as "ugly". The body also becomes very weak, often catches the flu, and the lips are always pale and colorless. Therefore, there are often aunts who remind my mother: "Is your daughter anemic? You should go to the hospital to get checked." When I went to the hospital for a check-up, my hemoglobin level was even higher than normal! My mother always thought that lack of nutrition during pregnancy made me weak, so she always tried to find ways to nourish me, but my physical condition remained unchanged.
