After that, because we studied Buddhism, we really became friends and had nothing to hide from each other.
Three years of high school passed in the blink of an eye. After that, we studied in two different cities, only seeing each other in
vacations. What did Bao Bao look like then? I remember he wore a pair of big glasses, the glasses were full of dust, his eyes were dull like a dead fish. When he walks, his back is bent and his gait sways like a large shrimp. Amitabha Buddha, what made such a handsome teenager become like this?
Luckily, in the big city, we all heard about Buddha's teachings and all believed in Buddha. Therefore, we are the most compatible friends in the group of classmates. He confessed to me that he has a bad habit, which is masturbation. This habit started during the summer vacation after completing middle school karma and from then on it couldn't be stopped. Sometimes I do it multiple times a day. Amitabha Buddha, now everything is clear. It was adultery and evil karma that made such an inherently talented teenager become like this! This is just an external expression, but his inner world is still indescribably painful. He is very shy, every time he goes out in public he is afraid, just greeting others takes all his courage. Usually he always tries to lock himself up, only then does he feel safe (masturbation can easily create this karma, because doing things cannot be seen by others, so he receives the karma of not daring to face others). Amitabha Buddha!!!
There's something even more horrifying: his body was completely exhausted. I'm worried that marriage will become a big challenge for him in the future! You can read the teachings of layperson Dinh Phuc Bao: What harmful effects does masturbation have on the body:
Body exhaustion, premature aging, kidney disease and many other diseases.
Ruined appearance, countless unsatisfactory things, difficult life, deadlocked career.
The body is weak, easily angry and cries, the penis is weak, the semen has no sperm, or completely loses the ability to have intercourse and becomes impotent.
Wet dreams, or frequent semen leakage, lead to spermatorrhea.
The following events are: After good karma, we all returned to Henan city. At this time, Bao Bao was very sincere in studying Buddha, reciting the Great Compassion Mantra, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra, reciting Buddha's name, and in life practicing "Liu Pham Four Teachings". We often do good deeds together, so I understand him better than anyone else. In the spring of 2005, when I met him again, I discovered that his appearance had completely changed. The face is very fresh, the spirit is full of vitality. I used to think that marriage was a big challenge for him, but now he has a pretty good wife. Later, they also had twins, a boy and a girl. These two children were also obtained by praying to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. It can be seen that the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra truly brings immeasurable benefits to sentient beings!
I asked Bao Bao about his experiences studying Buddhism. He said that he followed the teachings of layperson Qua Khanh, which was to quickly observe the precepts and stop eating living beings. No matter what method you practice, you must recite the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra once every day and dedicate merit to sentient beings throughout the dharma realm. In addition, he also emphasized walking and reciting Buddha's name while walking. One day and one night, I walk and recite Buddha's name, this helps to regulate my body and mind and increase my energy a lot. After walking for a few hours, it feels like all five organs in the body are washed once. The next day, I looked in the mirror and noticed my face was red.
That's right, everyone is Buddha Bodhisattva. What I see is you expressing your dharmakaya through your own story. Initially, it was about the evil consequences of adultery, then it was about making amends to receive blessings, and finally there was nothing left to be attached to, only gratitude for the Buddha's grace and the wish to repay. No need to say anything more. I just recite one sentence: "Namo Amitabha Buddha!"

tieu_de: ARTICLE BY COLLEGE OF HIS BA TUÇNG NHA CUSTOMER QU KHANH
tom_tat: Excerpt from the article of layperson Hai Ba: Layman Qua Khanh (Mr. Duong Tac Tuong) sacrificed his life for rebirth at 6:43 p.m. on August 21, 2018 (the author of this article is the character of the story in Notes on modern cause and effect...
noi_dung:
Excerpt from the article of layperson Hai Ba: Layman Qua Khanh (Mr. Duong Tac Tuong) sacrificed his life for rebirth at 6:43 p.m. on August 21, 2018 (the author of this article is the character of the story in Notes on modern cause and effect about reading the Ksitigarbha Sutra while pregnant).
After August 23 sent off layperson Qua Khanh, I wanted to write something. It's been a few years since I visited this forum, so much so that I forgot my password. I tried many ways but failed, then sent a message to admin Save, left a message on WeChat, even used my phone to register again but still failed. Tried again today on the computer, registered with the name "Hai Ba Tan" and finally succeeded.
When I received news of Master Qua Khanh's death, I was working far away. I hastily changed my ticket and got on the earliest flight back to Tianjin, but unfortunately I still couldn't see him one last time. Theo phong tục ở Thiên Tân, người mất sẽ được hỏa táng vào sáng sớm ngày thứ ba. Therefore, I just had time to see Master Qua Khanh's portrait placed among fresh flowers. He still looks gentle, just like when I first met him 25 years ago.
During the flight, I couldn't sleep, I kept thinking about the scene when I first met layman Qua Khanh in early 1993, as if it were just yesterday. I often call him teacher Duong. At that time, he had not yet arrived at the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, he was just a very ordinary middle-aged monk. Later,
When he returned from the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, he became famous throughout the country, preaching everywhere. One time, when I was at my teacher's house, I was lucky enough to receive a phone call from Venerable Master Hsuan Hua himself.
More than 10 years ago, Master Yang was so famous that I saw copies of the book Notes on Modern Cause and Effect in temples in Taiwan. Until 2010, he began to meditate and recuperate. The last time I saw him was 3 years ago, he still had a rosy face but his movements were no longer flexible. I specially invited Master Coc, the son of my eldest disciple, the famous doctor of the Four Great Chinese Physicians - Master Thi Jin Mac, to come with me to visit Master Yang. In 1994, the old monk of Dai Bi Pagoda - Master Bao Ham, had metastatic colon cancer, but did not accept Western medicine surgery but asked Master Coc's father, famous Chinese medicine doctor Coc Chan Anh in Tianjin, to treat him with Chinese medicine. Now, the old man is 98 years old. Unfortunately, when he heard that Mr. Coc's remedy contained animal ingredients, Mr. Duong politely refused.
Three years have passed, I still think that after my child takes the university entrance exam, I will visit Mr. Duong again. But unfortunately, the teacher is gone. However, I seem to feel that he has not really left, just gone to some far away place.
Extremely grateful to Master Duong for helping me connect with Buddha Dharma, grateful to him for teaching me 19 years ago when I was pregnant. When I went to see him, he advised me to chant the Ksitigarbha sutras, which I took seriously. After completing 49 chants, my son was born smoothly. I have also written many articles on the forum about this story. In the blink of an eye, 19 years have passed. Just like Mr. Duong once said, the child who returned my gratitude in the next life makes me extremely grateful. I have never
Take an extra class but still achieve excellent results. When my child was in 11th grade, he signed a contract to enroll directly into Chi Vien Academy of Shanghai Jiaotong University and Cau Thi Academy of Zhejiang University with standard scores. I won the silver medal in the national Math Olympiad and this year I passed the university entrance exam of my dream with a score of 683.
My child's high school principal texted me: “His 3 years of high school are the most ideal model in my view of education. You have your own interests, dedication, vision, and personal feelings. Although it is not easy for others to learn, seeing a child like that makes me feel very reassured.”
In particular, during my senior year, I always helped a classmate who ranked last in the class. This student often sits at the back of the class in the lab, and it seems like no one likes to sit at the same table as him. When I was assigned to sit with this friend, I happily accepted and became his good friend. Every day after school, I help him study until after 8pm before returning home. Grade 12 time is very precious, but you made that choice and I respect your decision. When the university entrance exam scores were announced, what made me happiest was that my classmate achieved 602 points and was accepted into Tianjin Civil Aviation Academy.
This world sometimes does not have applause. "Accumulating goodness is a teaching about cause and effect, nurturing the mind, using the books of Lao Tzu and Chuang Tzu as the foundation." Kindness is sometimes more valuable than excellence. I have never met that child's parents and don't need any thanks, but I believe that a child who is kind enough, no matter where he goes, I will feel secure, because kindness will light up his whole life path.
Even though I've known Master Duong for a long time, I'm not diligent and can't memorize the scriptures, so I'm always scared when I meet him. However, in my heart I always feel deeply grateful because he has guided me throughout my life. I heard that many people from all over the country also specially came to say goodbye to Master Duong one last time, to commemorate his contributions to the propagation of Buddha Dharma.
His wife was also very resilient, she did not cry, because he passed away in peace and was supported by many Buddha friends. Everything went very smoothly.
A person has passed away, completing a samsara of life, bringing with him remembrance and blessings from others. Like the spring rain that soaks the ground, he has enlightened so many minds. Such an ordinary life has become extraordinary.
Wishing Master Duong to leave suffering and be happy, return to the world to continue his vows.

tieu_de: COLLEGE OF THE ARMY KHANH GIANG RETURNED TO THE MILITARY IN LIEU DUONG
tom_tat: Master Guo Qing, for the sake of our four disciples in Liaoyang, arrived early in the morning at 3 o'clock from Wuxi to Hongqiao Airport, Shanghai, to fly to us. Last night we were able to welcome the teacher here at 9:30 p.m. During these...
noi_dung:
Master Guo Qing, for the sake of our four disciples in Liaoyang, arrived early in the morning at 3 o'clock from Wuxi to Hongqiao Airport, Shanghai, to fly to us. Last night we were able to welcome the teacher here at 9:30 p.m. In recent years, Master Qua Khanh has traveled throughout cities across the country, teaching and propagating the Buddha Dharma as the blessings of the four beings increased. When Master Qua Khanh lectures later, I hope the venerable monks and lay people won't bother him. If you have questions, you can write them down on paper, someone will collect them, classify them, and after the teacher finishes teaching, they will specifically answer them. This time, Mr. Duong taught here for three days, in the morning from 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. The temple staff has compassionately prepared lunch for everyone. You can dine here without having to run back and forth, without collecting money. Next, I would like to invite the abbot of Avalokitesvara Pagoda to give a welcome speech.
Dear teachers, knowledgeable people, and the general public: As spring turns to summer, heaven and earth are peaceful, the Dharma is prosperous, under the light of your blessings, heaven and earth are clear, mountains are towering. In order to light the lamp of the minds of sentient beings, to teach in all ten directions, so that the sentient beings of Avalokitesvara Temple and Liaoyang City can all enjoy the Buddha's teachings and board the Buddha's Dharma boat. At the invitation of the lay people in Harbin and the General Secretary of the Liaoyang Buddhist Association, good intellectual Guo Qing came to Liaoning.
Duong to exchange experiences learning Buddha with everyone. Layman Qua Khanh is a disciple of Venerable Master Hsuan Hua, who studied Buddhism at the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, USA. Under the blessings of noble people, lay people wrote the book Notes on modern cause and effect, and the book Mandarin Luong Hoang Sam, which many of us have read. We hope that sentient beings believe deeply in cause and effect, right faith, mindfulness, eliminate ignorance, recite Buddha's name, help eliminate many karma obstacles for sentient beings, and be generous to all living beings. The wisdom of layman Qua Khanh is inconceivable, he is a rare good and knowledgeable person. Please invite Master Qua Khanh to show us the way, help us develop a deep belief in cause and effect, and soon attain enlightenment. Personally, on behalf of Avalokitesvara Lieu Duong Pagoda, I would like to warmly welcome Master Duong to the lecture. Sincerely thank you for the presence of teacher Qua Khanh! At the same time, we would also like to welcome lay people and intellectuals from all over to our temple. Now, please welcome Mr. Qua Khanh with a warm round of applause.
- Lecture by layperson Qua Khanh (First cause and effect story)
I'm just a very ordinary person, thanks to encountering the Buddha's Dharma, I changed my ways. I don't have any special talents. If you consider me a good intellectual, that's fine, but calling me a great intellectual, I don't dare accept it. After studying Buddha, I felt that the more I studied Buddha, the further away I felt from Buddha's requirements. Perhaps everyone has read two of my books. Why did I write these two books? Because of a friend of mine, a few days ago we were chatting, but a few days later, his daughter called to say that her father had passed away. This got me thinking
Even myself, I could leave at any time. Therefore, I want to write down the stories that happened to me as a reference for those who are studying Buddhism.
My opportunity to learn Buddha seems to be different from others. Usually, people learn Buddha because they are advised by someone around them, or by reading a certain book. But I'm not like that. Why am I not like them? Because I, besides believing in the Communist Party and believing in myself, I don't believe in anyone. I don't believe in Buddha, Bodhisattva, or demons. During the Cultural Revolution, when the armed struggle took place, there was a person in my area who was about to die but was not dead, still breathing, and no one took care of him. I was there alone taking care of him. I don't believe there are ghosts. I don't believe anything.
People like me, Buddha and Bodhisattva who want to be converted, first use "desires to shield" (satisfy desires first), then lead to Buddha's wisdom. For example, if a person is about to starve to death, you tell him to recite Buddha, recite Amitabha Buddha and he will no longer be hungry. No matter how he chants, he's still hungry, right? So what to do? You must "seek the shield" first. You give him a dumpling or rice to fill his stomach, then explain to him the principles of Buddhism. Then you help him find a job, so he feels like you are a good, trustworthy person. At this time, when you tell him to believe in Buddha and recite Buddha's name, maybe he will accept. Buddha and Bodhisattva used this method on me. Because I don't believe in anything, but I have a hobby of reading books.
I work in the commercial industry, previously I worked in Tianjin, then was transferred to Xinjiang. After the Cultural Revolution, I was transferred to Tianjin again. I am the resident representative of the factory in Tianjin,
The job is very leisurely, it can be said that it is a blessing from a previous life. After that, the agency bought me a house, let me work from home, and installed a phone for me. At that time, normal houses did not have telephones, but my house did. So later, Venerable Master Hsuan Hua called my house, which was very miraculous.
What method did Buddha Bodhisattva use to lead me into Buddha's door? That suddenly gave me supernatural powers, and in this way I entered the Buddha gate, because before I completely did not believe in Buddhist teachings. The reason is because I hate monks. Why is that? When I was young, I watched movies and read novels, which portrayed people leaving the home life as people who lived under blue lights, banged on wooden drums, looked like pioneers, and were very respectable. But during the Cultural Revolution, Buddhism was destroyed and the monks returned to the secular world. After the Cultural Revolution, Buddhism began to recover. When I went to Chengdu for a conference, after the conference we went to Emei Mountain to play. At Mount Nga Mi there is a pagoda called Van Nien Tu. There, I met a monk for the first time. That monk was about 30 years old, a little taller than me. He walked with his hands behind his back and took leisurely steps in the yard of Van Nien Pagoda. He held a cigarette in his mouth. The cigarette in his mouth was rotated around and around, looking very skillful. So, when I saw that monk, I felt hate in my heart, thinking: These monks are all freeloaders, so young they refuse to work, they just stay here and smoke cigarettes to make a living. In the temple's vegetarian restaurant, there are also chickens, ducks, fish, braised meat, braised chicken, lion's head dishes, and fish balls. We look and think: Why do monks eat meat? I specifically looked for a teacher to ask: "Teacher, why are there chickens, ducks, fish, and meat in a vegetarian house? Do monks also eat meat? He said: "Those are all fake, not real." But I still have doubts in my heart: If you don't eat chicken, duck, fish, or meat, why bother making it?
fake items like that? From that moment on, I began to have an aversion to Buddhism.
Also at the Great Compassion Monastery in Tianjin, I saw an old monk who had returned to the world. He ran a small shop in the temple. The shop wasn't open yet, someone looked in through the window, and he loudly yelled at them. I saw it and thought: This monk, is it okay for people to just look at him? He even shouted loudly at people. Each of us has a measure in our hearts. At that time, I thought the person leaving the home life had to be pure, but he shouted loudly, which made me have a grudge against the monk. Therefore, at that time I absolutely hated Buddhism, and had no intention of learning Buddhism. I absolutely do not want to go to the "place where Buddha scriptures circulate" to find scriptures to read, because I think that if the monks are so obnoxious, then the Buddha scriptures must not be any good. At that time, I thought that the Buddha's scriptures had been around for thousands of years and were just historical records, so I didn't want to read them. For someone like me, if someone came to advise me to believe in Buddha, would I believe it? Absolutely not. That was my mood before studying Buddha.
When did I enter Buddha's door? It was during Tet in 1988. One day, my wife asked me to punch her back. She works in finance and plays the abacus all day so she's tired. She lies down at night and wants me to help pat her back. I like lying in bed reading books. When I prepare to punch, before I prepare to do it, I think: "If I had the ability like the qigong masters on TV, that would be great. I just need to do the exercises and she'll be cured immediately." At that time, qigong was very popular in the country. I was just thinking about it, before I even touched her body, she suddenly said her back no longer hurt. I stopped and asked: "It really doesn't hurt anymore?". She replied: "It really doesn't hurt anymore." "How does it feel?". "Numb and hot." I think: "Isn't it like what the TV says?".
I started to think, is this due to mental effects? Why did she feel numbness and heat as soon as she raised her hand, just thinking about that?
I'd like to test further to see what's going on. I moved my hand up to her neck, about a meter away, and asked: "Do you feel your back hotter now than before?". She replied: "The back is not hot, but the neck is hot." Hearing that, I was very happy, thinking: "Oh, my hands have power now!"
So I told her to get up and stand in front of me. I joked, rolled up my sleeves, pretended to be like the qigong masters on TV, and then held out my hands to do the exercises. Before I could attack, I had just rolled up my sleeves and said: "In a little while, I will cure you and cure your illness." Actually, she doesn't have any major illnesses, just a few minor illnesses. But as soon as I finished speaking, before I could even reach out my hand, she said: "My whole body is numb, hot, and there is a cold air coming from the soles of my feet." "Really?" "It's real". I walked closer to her feet and reached out to touch them, it was indeed cold. I backed away further, closer to the furniture, about a meter and a half away from her, still feeling that cold air. Suddenly, I remembered what the qigong masters on TV said that cold air is disease air. I thought this disease could spread to others, so I quickly said: "Get to the ground, get to the ground, this sick air." According to qigong theory, I told the sick air to go to the ground, and indeed the cold air flow went down. At that moment, the cold air near the furniture disappeared, only to be felt near her feet, then continued to disappear underground. I continued to move my hand down, the cold air from the soles of my feet curved and went down. When my hand approached the carpet, I still felt the cold air.
This is my first time experiencing these things. What I said is true, I don't have magical powers, but
Why are my words so effective? Just a moment later, she said: "Now there is no more cold air, only hot air." At that time I understood that cold air is disease air, and hot air must be quintessential air. If the hot air runs out, people will die, so I was so scared that I said: "Stop, stop, stop!". And indeed, the hot air stopped immediately. She said she couldn't feel the heat anymore. I immediately walked over and touched it, there was nothing left. Think about it, how did I feel at that time? I haven't studied anything, haven't practiced anything, and don't believe in anything, yet such a miracle happened. She was sweating all over. I touched her and her whole body was drenched in sweat. To me, this is unbelievable. You don't know how happy I am, I thought: "Wow, in just a moment, I became a fairy!"
My wife said: "Don't go treat other people's illnesses." I asked: "Why?" She said: "Because I like treating people." Previously, I taught myself acupuncture and massage, often doing it in my spare time. I immediately give a needle to anyone who is sick, even though I have never learned from anyone. My family has a tradition of Oriental medicine, from my father, grandfather to my uncle, all are Oriental medicine doctors. In my lifetime, no one studied medicine anymore, but I still have that hobby. She said: "Don't treat other people's illnesses, otherwise you will die of fatigue." I replied: "This is not tiring at all. You don't have to use any force. Just say a few words and your illness will be cured." I also added: "If someone asks me to treat a disease, I will treat them without charge." At that time, I said no money, not like now after studying Buddha and then making vows not to take money. I think it doesn't cost me anything, I just need to say a few words and people will be cured. That night, I was very excited.
The next morning, when my children went to school and I was alone at home, I asked myself: "Is what happened last night real or fake? I have god
is it clear? Is this magical power real or fake?". I need to find someone to try. I immediately went to find my mother-in-law. She used to smoke cigarettes, so she had chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Later she stopped smoking, but the disease still made it difficult for her to breathe. During Tet, because many grandchildren came to her house, she was so tired, her illness relapsed, she could only lie down on her pillow and sleep. I thought I would test it with her to see if what happened last night was true or not. So I came to find her. When she arrived, she was at home, unable to lie down and had to lean on a pillow. I asked: "Mom still not feeling well?". She replied: "Not healthy yet". When talking, wheezing sounds are heard very clearly. I said: "Can I cure your mother?". She agreed immediately, because she thought I would give her acupuncture again like before. I used to give her acupuncture, but then I stopped doing it. Her son once said: "Brother-in-law, you're not a doctor. If you cure it, that's good, but if it doesn't, can you bear the responsibility?" I think: "That's right, I'm the son-in-law, if unfortunately the needle is wrong, how can I explain it?". Therefore, I stopped giving her acupuncture from then on.
This time, I wanted to experiment, but she thought I was going to do acupuncture, so she asked: "Where are you going to light it?". I said: "I won't light it. Mom, just close your eyes and it's okay." I asked her to close her eyes so she wouldn't see me. I put my hand on her head and asked: "Mom, do you feel anything?". She replied: "There's no feeling at all." I thought maybe she didn't understand what I meant, so I asked again: "Mom, do you feel anywhere hot or cold?". She said: "Mom's head feels a bit hot." At that time, my hand was above her head, about a meter away. I think: "Oh, I'm really diligent!". In my head I thought: "My energy will enter from the top of her head, and all diseases in the body will be pushed out through the legs." I thought so in my head. Her feet were bound since feudal times and were only removed later.
Just as I was thinking that, she said: "Now the mother feels numb and cold air is coming out of the soles of her feet." I was very happy to hear that,
think: "Oh, I'm really diligent!". I brought my hand close to her leg, and I could actually feel the cold air. At that time, I was extremely happy. On TV, qigong masters say that when performing healing exercises, each session will last about half an hour and a treatment session is ten times. I thought I should follow that rule, that day I treated her for about half an hour. When I pulled my hand away, her breathing was much better, but there were still some problems. I immediately focused on her Thien Dot point, a key point for treating asthma that I learned about when studying acupuncture. I think: "Can I use my fingers instead of acupuncture needles to treat her?". I used two fingers to place the Thien Dot acupuncture point and only thought in my mind: "Stop coughing, stop coughing, stop coughing...". It really worked, and I'm extremely happy. That day, she was able to go to work. The next day, when I arrived, she was able to clean the floor. On the third day, she was steaming dumplings. I began to believe that I had powers, but I didn't know where this supernatural power came from. I just find this very interesting, because I have always loved treating other people's illnesses.
First of all, I don't believe in qigong, I don't believe in Buddhism or any religion, I don't believe in anything, so how can I have this ability? Bệnh nhân đầu tiên là vợ của tôi, bệnh nhân thứ hai là mẹ vợ tôi, bệnh nhân thứ ba... After having this ability, I started telling my friends about it. My friend said: "No way". I said: "Really." He said: "Then you should try to cure my wife. She has been having trouble sleeping for four years now. She can't sleep." So I went to his house, the house was very small, I sat on a chair, his child sat on the bed watching TV, the room was so small that there was no room for two chairs. I put my hand on his wife's head, he stood next to watch, my hand rotated on her head like no one taught me to do. Suddenly, I felt a fire appear in my hand,
Like static electricity on a sweater, it made an explosive "click" sound, my friend stared at me wide-eyed. I said: "Oh my, why are there sparks?". He said: "Did you just realize? Just now when you raised your hand, it was there." What's so strange about this, I don't even know.
After that, my hand continued to rotate on her head, suddenly the TV screen started flashing, "sizzling sizzling", I thought it was the sound of a car on the street, but they said: "We can't hear the sound of cars here." I did an experiment, every time I turned my hand, the TV sure enough appeared noisy lines. I think: "Is this the process?". After that, I kept thinking, not understanding what this was all about.
From then on, I started treating people at home, first friends, then friends of friends, then friends of friends of friends. I just need to say one sentence and their illness will be cured. But I still don't know why I have this ability? Why do I have this special ability? I always want to find a teacher to ask clearly what this is all about.
At that time, qigong was very popular. In Tianjin there is a qigong class, the tuition is thirty yuan, the registration fee is one yuan. I'm a very frugal person, but to understand why I have this ability, I spent thirty-one dollars to register. Qigong masters teach people how to move energy and how to collect energy. One time, while studying, the qigong master asked: "If you want to quit smoking, raise your hand." I also raised my hand. When the teacher gave the gong and asked you to smoke, as soon as you smoked, the cigarette immediately turned into paper, without any flavor. He also helped people lose weight. One person used a tape measure to measure his waist, three meters. After the teacher performed the effort, he measured it again to only two nine meters. At that time, in Bat Nhat hall in Tianjin, there were often such performances. For example, calling someone up on stage, the qigong master says: "You rotate
a circle for everyone to see your neck". The person's neck has a tumor, called a lymph node. Qigong master said: "Please say after me: From now on I will only do bad things, not good things." He followed: "From now on I will only do bad things, not good things." The people sitting in the front row saw clearly, they shouted: "It's getting bigger! It's getting bigger!" That person was frightened and quickly shouted: "I don't do bad things, only good things." The tumor became smaller again. We were extremely surprised, as if the tumor understood the words, saying "only do bad things, do not do good things", it immediately grew bigger, said "don't do bad things, only do good things", it became smaller again. It's amazing, this is the first time I've seen it. Qigong master said: "I will bring the atmosphere from Son Trang Thua Duc Resort to everyone." A moment later, when the curtains opened on the stage, a breath of fresh air rushed in. I think: "Qigong is so powerful! I thought qigong gave people this special ability."
Actually, at that time I was healing others every day, I just didn't understand why I had this ability. Before, I could help others open their heavenly eyes, but not anymore. At that time, I talked to many people. Just by raising my hand, many people below opened their heavenly eyes. Some girls, after opening their heavenly eyes, came to me the next day and said: "Master Duong, please help me close my heavenly eye. Yesterday when I went home to sleep, I looked next to me and saw that my husband was just a skeleton. I was scared to death, please help me close it." So after that, I no longer opened my heavenly eyes to others. I just need to raise my hand and close it for them right away. If someone tells me that they are very brave, they are not afraid of staying next to the dead all night, and want me to open their heavenly eyes, I will also open them. At that time, I was treating people, just thinking in my head: "No
then". So they were truly cured. A patient with a broken bone and a splint came to me. I looked at them and said: "It's okay!". Having said that, they were truly cured, lying down on the ground and doing push-ups without any problem. Some people were carried there but walked home on their own. That moment was truly magical. But I don't know what this is all about.
At that time, many people came to my house, I treated them, changed the smell of cigarettes, just to have fun. "Namo Amitabha Buddha, Namo Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva", which means Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara, I want to be your student. Therefore, when we chant, we must add the two words "Namo".
After Buddhism spread to China, all temples had writing on the outside walls: “Namo Amitabha Buddha”, but now most newly built temples only have the four words “Amitabha Buddha” left, which is not true. Initially, master sat in the middle, but now he sat under the stage, letting me sit in the middle. My legs were shaking. I have never seen such a big scene.
- The sixth cause and effect story taught by layman Qua Khanh in Liaoyang
Venerable Master Hsuan Hua spoke first: “The Dharmas, the lay people, the long-awaited Yang lay people have finally arrived in the United States. He is a lay person. Just by reading a few of my teaching books, he was able to study Buddha, correct his mistakes, understand clearly and then practice. He led more than a hundred people to study Buddha, and more than twenty of them attained the five eyes and six eyes. I think: Why can't I teach my disciples like that? Well, it turns out it's because I, the teacher, haven't practiced well."
Hearing this, I felt embarrassed, I just wanted the ground to crack to make room for me to crawl under. I looked around, this side
are the Bhikkhus, behind them are the lay men. On the other side were the nuns, behind them were the lay women, all looking at me. It's been half a year since the first time I talked to the United States on the phone, everyone around Venerable Master Hsuan Hua knows about this, everywhere he goes he praises me, everyone praises me. But the people in front of me right now are different, they are all pure people, they are leaving the home life sitting in front, not Bhikkhus, then Bhikkhunis, otherwise they are also lay people. The nuns in the audience did not look directly at me, I felt they did not welcome me. Where I sit doesn't seem like my place, not where I should be. They are all pure people.
I think back on the bad things I did: killing, stealing, greed. I did a lot of bad things. In my heart I asked myself: How am I qualified to sit in such a pure place like this? If it weren't for Venerable Master Hsuan Hua's request, I wouldn't be here. Me sitting here is polluting this environment. I am not worthy to talk about Buddha Dharma here. So I don't know what to say, the words have come to my mouth but I can't say them. What to say? I do not know.
"'Me, my last name is Duong'. Isn't this redundant? Venerable Master Hsuan Hua just introduced to everyone, saying that this is the layman surnamed Duong. I also don't know how to talk about Buddha's teachings, I can only talk about my experience studying Buddhism. I told them about how I entered the Buddha gate, just like I told you this morning. At that time, I wanted to buy a house, and when I told the leaders at the unit, they agreed. I have already chosen a house worth thirty-four thousand dong. After choosing it, I want to move house. At that time, I was at a friend's house, he said: 'It's okay, just wait until the house over there is finished repairing before moving. You can fix it slowly'. At that time, the real estate market was not yet open, I was worried
that if the house price increases after waiting for the repair to be completed and requires me to pay an additional ten thousand, what will I do? Ten thousand at that time was a very large number. So, I deposited two thousand dong and went to Chengdu to attend the conference. After the conference, we went to Emei Mountain in Sichuan to play. My car was parked in the parking lot of Van Nien Pagoda, and a senior sister in my unit, also named Duong, called me: 'Tieu Duong, let's go together'. She pulled my hand and said: „Come with me, come with me‟. The mountain road was full of tall trees. Together we climbed to the highest point, which was Van Nien Pagoda. When she entered the temple, she told me: „Tieu Duong, please keep an eye on me, see if anyone from your unit has arrived yet, I want to pay homage to the Buddha‟. I said: “Oh, do you believe in Buddha too? What a superstition'. She said: „Once you get here, pay homage to the Buddha‟. I said: „If you pay homage to the Buddha, then pay homage to the Buddha, why do you tell me to look out for others?‟. At that time, many people did not believe in Buddha. If others saw it and reported it to the leaders, they would be in trouble. So she said: „You look out for me, look out for me‟. At that time, believing in Buddha had to be believed secretly. She took some incense sticks, put them in the incense burner, and bowed to the Buddha. After bowing, she said to me: „Tieu Duong, you also bow once, bow once‟. I said: „Are you telling me to bow like this?‟. At that time, I was wearing a suit. At that time, in China, people were just starting to wear suits, and the number of people wearing suits was very small. The leaders at the unit forced me to wear a suit, because I had to go to a meeting at the Ministry of Trade. The Ministry of Trade held a national meeting every year, and I represented the unit at the meeting. The leader said that I must dress neatly and represent the image of the unit, and told me to set an example for the unit. I really don't like wearing suits."
"I was told by the unit to have two suits sewn and the unit would refund the money. So I went to Peiluo Meng store in Shanghai, the best suit tailor shop, to have two suits made. One silver-gray suit made from pure lamb's wool, and one mauve suit
coffee. It was the first time I wore a silver-gray suit, with a crisp white shirt, a handkerchief in the pocket, and even a tie. Tell me to pay homage to the Buddha in this form? Oh my God, look at the people paying homage to the Buddha, they wear big cloths and grass sandals, and I'm dressed like this, how can I pay homage to the Buddha?. I said: 'I won't bow'. She said: „bowing to the Buddha, bowing to the Buddha‟. Definitely force me to bow. If she were a man and told me to bow to the Buddha, I would absolutely not bow, but now that she is a woman, I still call her big sister, just hold my hand and pull me, telling me to bow to the Buddha. She pulled me to the point where I really had no choice. I said: „What are you doing? If you bow to the Buddha, just bow, why do you drag me along to bow?'. She said: „After coming here, how can I not bow?‟. I said: „What is the use of bowing to the Buddha?‟. She said: "If anything happens, just pray to Buddha." I said: „If I pray to Buddha and my pockets swell, I will bow‟. She said: 'May Buddha bless you not to get sick'. I said: "If that's the case, then why do you need to see a doctor?" I was so attached to her that I had no choice but to think that I would just bow. I asked: 'How do you bow?' She said: "Take a coin to buy a bunch of incense." At that time, one coin could buy a bowl of rice. A big bowl of rice, a spoonful of vegetables, and even meat. There was no other way, I had to bow. I said:
"Please help me, don't let anyone in the unit see you." At that time, bowing to the Buddha was considered humiliating, unlike now, which is much more free. At that time, I had no other choice but to bow to the Buddha. Mouth mumbling: „May my family be healthy!‟. Then put incense on it. I think: Transferring a house's name is very difficult, some people work for a whole year and still don't get it done. If I go home and the house transfer matter is resolved immediately, then I will believe Buddha. I didn't know how to bow, I just felt my cheeks burning. After bowing, I stood up and ran away, while the big sister behind me said: 'Oh my god, wait for me'. That was the first time I bowed to the Buddha."
"Then I returned to Tianjin, and a miracle happened. Suddenly I thought of it and asked my wife: 'Do you know anyone at the Police? Are you familiar with the person who works at the Housing Management Department of the Police?'. She said: 'Yes, my karma's husband is a police officer, and also an official'. So I went to see that police officer. After meeting, he said I was his friend and asked another old policeman to take me to go through the procedures to transfer the house's title. As a result, after only five days, all procedures for transferring my house's name were completed. When I finished renovating the house and moved into this big house, my new house was empty inside because there was little furniture at that time, very empty. My karma came to visit, and after looking at it, he said: 'Tieu Duong is really unusual, having a big house like this'. At that time, after my house was repaired, everyone who came to see it said I lived in a house reserved for Ministers. Two carpeted rooms, bathroom, kitchen, fully equipped. There is also a large yard, ten meters long and five meters wide. It was here that I began to study Buddhism.
After I returned from America and had studied Buddhism for a year, I went to thank Ms. Duong, telling her that I had already studied Buddhism, and had even gone to America to meet Venerable Master Hsuan Hua. I went to thank her and advised her not to eat meat. She said: 'It's impossible not to eat meat, it has no nutrients'. I said: 'Don't be confused, you told me to bow to the Buddha'. Now that I believe in Buddha to this extent, I even went to America and told her to become a vegetarian but she still refused. Did you forget that you pulled me bowing to the Buddha before? She said: 'Tieu Duong, at that time it was like this: Because only you know I'm bowing to the Buddha, if you don't bow, if one day you accidentally say something, won't my life be over?'. I originally came to thank her, but after hearing her say that, I thought: This woman is so sinister. She was afraid that I would say anything, so she forced me to bow to the Buddha. Actually, the fact that she told me to bow to the Buddha was to help me
In my next life, I will enter the Buddha gate. When I mentioned this, the nuns sitting below all laughed. Their mouths laughed so loudly that they stretched all the way up here, their eyes squinted into a line, kept laughing, but their eyes did not look at me. At that time, the precepts there stipulated that nuns could not look at Bhikkhus, and Bhikkhus could not look at nuns either. When a Bhikkhu and a nun meet, they both have to kneel down to pay respect to each other, both have to kneel down and bow their heads, and that was the first time I saw this."
I have read Venerable Master Hsuan Hua's Buddhist teachings. He is truly a great monk. He once made vows, vowing that all the suffering of sentient beings in this world would be endured by him alone for them. Therefore, he can endure everything, including food and drink. He only drank some thin porridge, but as for food, they made four dishes for him. To avoid complications, they poured all four dishes into the porridge, only one small bowl, just the amount of one bite we ate. Every day he only ate that little. One time, he didn't eat anything for two days in a row. We advised him to eat, but he said he was not hungry. Disciple said: "Monk, you should eat something." He replied again: "I'm not hungry." Your disciple came to talk to me again. I said: "Master, you have to eat. People often say: 'People are steel, rice is iron', if you don't eat rice, how can you live?". He replied: "I don't want to eat." I said again: "If you don't want to eat, you have to eat. We've already prepared it, you have to eat." This isn't rice, it's just a glass of oatmeal. I said: "Master, you have to eat." He replied: "It's afternoon now, we have taken the precept not to eat after noon." I said: "This is not a meal, it's medicine. Haven't you said that the food of people leaving the home life is called 'medicinal food'? This is medicine. If your body is sick, you must take medicine. You must eat." I'm not like other disciples who strictly follow it, I just keep saying: "You must eat,
If you don't eat, you can't do it." He replied: "Oh, you're so clever. Okay, I'll drink." Then he took the cup and drank.
After drinking, I saw there was still a lot of porridge on the rim of the glass. At that time, there was no oatmeal in our country, so a lot of oatmeal still stuck to the sides of the glass. He told me to add a little more water, then he drank more, then told me to add a little more water, then drank again. I stood next to him and said: "Master, it's gone, it's clean." He told me to add more water and drink more. He sat on the bed, legs crossed, continuing to drink water and rinse his mouth. He 'collapsed' and rinsed his mouth... On the mainland, when rinsing their mouth, people often find a basin to spit the water out, but in America there is no such basin. Before I could find him, he 'collapsed' and swallowed all the mouthwash. I immediately asked: "Master, why did you swallow the mouthwash?". He replied: "There's nothing to worry about. My mouth is not dirty. I still have some food in my teeth, I can't let it go to waste."
When he said that sentence, I felt very moved in my heart. I also never waste food, but I've never been able to do it like you, to the point of not even throwing away mouthwash because there's food in it. From then on, I didn't dare waste anything anymore. As for the tissue you use, the tissue in America is square and very large. When you use it to wipe your mouth, only use a small corner. After using it, he folded the corner, put it in his sleeve, and the next time he used it again, he would use the folded part. After using it, he folded it again and continued to use it. One piece of paper, you can use two to three days, at least two days. I once saw him use a piece of paper for seven days. Another time, we were meditating, and after finishing, he called his disciple and asked him to bring him a tissue next to the pillow on the bed. Disciple said: "The tissue is dirty, I threw it in the trash." He said: "How can I throw it away? Quickly take it out for me, I haven't used it all yet." Disciple said: "Master, it's too dirty, I can't
can be used anymore". He replied: "I've only used it for two days, I haven't used it all yet, I don't have such great blessings that I can waste it like that. Doing so will result in retribution. Can't do that." Those are things I have seen with my own eyes.
Also, although I didn't see it with my own eyes, I heard it from Venerable Master Hsuan Hua's disciples. One time, several monks from Taiwan came to stay at the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas. They only eat one meal a day, the meal includes rice, dumplings, large bread, small bread, vegetarian margarine, fruit, fruit jam - whatever they want to eat, but only one meal a day. Why only one meal? Venerable Master Hsuan Hua preached that it was established by Buddha. When Buddha was still alive, monks begged for food, not begged for food. They hold alms bowls and stand in front of people's houses. If they make offerings, they eat them. If not, then they don't and never ask. If the first family gives enough food, they will not go anymore. If it's not enough, they go to the second house, and if they can't eat it all, they share it with other hungry beings. That was the scene at that time, absolutely no cooking for yourself.
In addition, studying Buddha Dharma is to eliminate desires, especially male and female desires. Master said that if the stomach is hungry, desires can be less. Let people be a little hungry so they won't think about unnecessary things, like lust. So, eat only one meal a day.
Those three Taiwanese monks, after finishing eating, recited the dedicating merit mantra and prepared to leave. Suddenly, Venerable Master Hsuan Hua appeared before them: "What's going on?". "Master! We can't chew." Looking back, on everyone's plate there was a piece of food that they chewed but couldn't swallow. "Master, I can't chew this food." "Can't chew it?" Food at the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas does not have to be purchased
from the supermarket. Their dishes are all vegetables picked up from the supermarket, things that the supermarkets throw away, meaning spoiled or withered vegetables. A few days ago, television in the UK also showed supermarkets wasting a lot of fruits and vegetables. If it wilts a little, they won't sell it anymore, unlike in our country, where people soak it in water and continue to sell it. But in America, if it's just a little dry, they throw it all away. In the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, you leave the home life and eat those thrown away vegetables and fruits. Every morning, at around 9 o'clock, female lay followers of the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas come to pick vegetables. Each of us, when we first arrived, had different tasks of picking vegetables: Tomato picker, cucumber picker, eggplant picker... We drove to the landfill, waiting until 9 a.m. when the truck from the supermarket carrying discarded vegetables arrived. Seeing vegetables and fruits being thrown away, you will also say: "If they throw away such good fruits and vegetables, it's such a waste." Therefore, everything that is still edible is used, including cabbage, even if the roots have been chopped to the point where they cannot be cut anymore. When cooked, it may not be tender enough, so you won't be able to chew it. Potatoes were cut into four parts, and people from big cities didn't want to eat them. The cabbage stalks are dry and can't be chewed. Venerable Master Hsuan Hua says: "For those of you leaving the home life in the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas, there is no vegetable you can't chew."
So when the Venerable asked them, they said it was a dish they couldn't chew. The monk used his hand to pick up a few pieces of half-chewed food from their plates. The disciples clasped their hands but did not dare to say anything. He picked up each piece, put it in his mouth, chewed, chewed, chewed, and finally swallowed it. The disciples saw this and immediately knelt down. "We can still eat, don't waste it." That is Venerable Master Hsuan Hua. I didn't witness it directly, but two people told me about it. I tell this story to remind that, whether we are lay people or masters, we all have to know how to save in the future.
"Someone is bullying you, right?". One person asked layperson Qua Khanh, why do people always make things difficult for him? Even when he left the home life, they still did not let him go. Layman Qua Khanh replied: "Let me tell you, in your previous life you were a farmer, you raised a donkey. I have a bad temper, the donkey doesn't listen, I don't scold it, I hit it. Why does it do the trick? Because in his previous life he owed you something. Every time I get angry, I beat him, every day. In this life, the person who comes to cause trouble for you is the donkey that you used to constantly beat. Just because you left the home life doesn't mean they don't ask for your debt anymore. When I leave the home life, they still come to make things difficult for me, let me suffer, that is helping me spend karma. Suffering is the end of suffering, this is what Venerable Master Hsuan Hua taught. Enjoying happiness is spending happiness. In this life, I came to pay the karma of suffering, so people leaving the home life cannot seek enjoyment, only fools seek enjoyment. If you're already leaving the home life, why do you still want to enjoy happiness? Each person has a cause and effect relationship, the blessings and sufferings that a person must endure are the same, like two parallel lines. One way is the happiness you will enjoy in this life, the other way is suffering you must endure. We, people of this age, mostly suffer first. Like me, I worked for many years in Xinjiang, then worked again in Tianjin, suffering a lot. Born into a family without good conditions, I have suffered since childhood. Venerable Master Hsuan Hua teaches that suffering is the end of suffering. For example, this is the straight line of suffering, every day you endure a little suffering, you have eliminated a little suffering. Every day you suffer, you spend a little more. If you continue to suffer, the suffering will end, and when the suffering ends, sweetness will come. You see, this line represents suffering, and when you continuously eliminate suffering, suffering will gradually disappear, leaving only sweetness. Elderly people like us have suffered a lot in the past
past, so life is now better. Suffering is the end of suffering, enjoying happiness is the end of happiness. Now, children are loved and cared for by the whole family like a prince or princess, what does this mean? Born to enjoy happiness. But enjoying happiness is consuming happiness. This is the straight line of suffering, this is the straight line of happiness. Enjoying happiness means spending happiness. To enjoy happiness is to consume the blessings, and when the blessings run out, suffering will come. What's left will only be suffering."
Let's talk about the boy in Harbin who, at just thirteen years old, had kidney failure. Why is that? First, because his parents are not good. In today's society, there are a lot of pornographic movies, his parents like to watch those movies, their behavior is inappropriate, they don't think about their children. Maybe the boy couldn't sleep, while his parents were doing lewd things, making him see. So the boy does those things himself every day, nowadays children develop earlier. Like in our time, eighteen or nineteen years old still didn't know what finding a girlfriend was, didn't know what it was all about. Now children from a young age watch TV, play on the computer, and even young children know everything. Love affairs, sexual behavior, and masturbation very early on, so at the age of thirteen he developed kidney failure.
Second, it also has to do with your past life. In his previous life, he was a wealthy man who liked to bully others, rape women, and had a child with a woman but did not accept it. Previous lives have created a lot of karma. Currently, his mother, in her previous life, was his servant. Because at that time, the servant not only did not advise him not to do bad things, but also assisted him, often helping him commit evil. Therefore, in this life, his mother felt very miserable because of his illness. What is the cause? It is due to karma created in a previous life. The law of cause and effect is scary, every disease is the same
regarding this. Therefore, you must pay attention to the cause, do not create bad causes. Whatever the cause, the result will be reaped, that's for sure.
We have done something wrong in the past, we need to quickly repentance. When I talk about repentance, I have to use my "mind" to repentance, not reading the repentance text, that doesn't work. You need to realize from your heart that you were wrong and make sure you don't do it again in the future. That is true repentance. For example, now I do something bad, I want to go to the police station to admit my mistake, I have to admit it from my heart, otherwise I'm afraid that the people at the police station won't pay attention to me. Admitting false mistakes, people have seen it many times. What is the way to write "sam (忏)" in repentance? This is the simplified word, the traditional word is written like this: "懺". Why is there a "mind" set on the left? The "mind" set is for us to focus on the mind, focus on repentance, not just use the mouth to repentance. You hit me, scold me, I tell you: "I was wrong, please forgive me." Do you forgive me? No way. For example, I once killed your child, now you come to take revenge, I say: "Sorry, I was wrong, please forgive me." Can you forgive me? You will not forgive. Therefore, when repentance, we must be sincere in repentance, use sincerity, and repentance for conflicts between people. The word "sam" on the right is two people standing on the word "戈", the word "戈" is a weapon, also a killing tool, below is the word "phi", plus one stroke. Why "one stroke"? For example, I owe you two thousand dong, you write it down in the book, now I pay you, do you draw "one horizontal line" or "one line" on that two thousand dong? The word "repentance" has the word "repentance" underneath which is "a stroke", meaning all the karma that you have created, if you use your heart, truly repentance for the conflicts between you and others, as well as the right and wrong between people. For example I say you are wrong, you say I am not good, if you can honestly repentance,
All karma sins will be erased. Therefore, all the wrong things that we have done, we must sincerely repentance.
In the past I harmed your life, in this life you chase and kill me, I tell you: "I can't die yet, my child is not yet an adult. Please forgive me. I will apologize to you." Is that possible? So will you forgive me? You will say: "Your child is not yet an adult, but at that time, my child was not an adult either, why did you harm me?". You won't forgive me.
The repentance method I mentioned is definitely to take your own life and death lightly. Now you chase and kill me. Before, I hid, but now I don't hide anymore. I know that killing people must pay for their lives, because all living beings are equal. Shakyamuni Buddha in the Mahaparinirvana Sutra said that the Buddha considered sentient beings as Rahula, and Rahula was the son of the Buddha. Buddha looked at pigs, horses, cows, sheep, flies, ants, mosquitoes, even maggots in the toilet as well as his own son.
Therefore, us now eating the flesh of living beings is no different from eating the flesh of Shakyamuni Buddha's other children. On one hand I eat meat, on the other hand I worship Buddha, saying: "Buddha Bodhisattva blesses me, like this, like that." Do you think Buddha Bodhisattva will bless you? So, now I know I was wrong, I have to repentance before Buddha, saying that before I didn't know, I killed countless lives, now I know I was wrong, in the future I will definitely correct it, no longer kill and eat meat, no longer do evil. Not only do I myself not do evil, but I must also advise everyone not to do evil. I don't care what happens when I die, I don't think about that. If the words I speak have merit, I vow to dedicate this merit to the sentient beings I have killed,
ate meat, hoping they would escape suffering and be happy. As for me, when I die, I will go wherever I go.
I hope after you hear what I have to say, you will do the same. Later, we will dedicating the merit of chanting sutras, reciting the Buddha, and the merit of releasing life to the sentient beings we have hurt. The Ksitigarbha Sutra must be persistently recited, and the Buddha's name must also be persistently recited.
People chanting Buddha's sutras must definitely read the sutras. If you don't read the sutras, you will not understand the true wonderful meaning of Buddha's teachings. Why is that? Because in the Shurangama Sutra it says: "A person who eats the five flavors of Tan can preach twelve sutras, but the gods of the ten directions hate their stench and all stay away." If I know how to preach the twelve sutras and you are all Devas, today you come to listen to the sutra, as soon as you enter the house, smell the bad smell, know that today I have eaten onions, garlic, chives, the whole room is filled with an unpleasant smell, you enter the house and immediately want to leave.
Just like me, if I go into a meat restaurant, no matter how high-class it is, as soon as I enter the room, I can smell the fishy smell of animals in the air. This smell immediately hits the nose, it can arouse the desire to eat meat, but vegetarians find the smell very unpleasant. People who are pure to a certain extent will have such feelings. You must definitely eliminate this from the root to be a true practitioner. You must give up salty foods, then put your body outside of life and death. Like me, having killed so many ants, I now want to go to the world of Ultimate Bliss, but I don't dare to think about it.
Now I only need something that has merit, I will do: preach sutras, preach dharma, print sutras, release animals, and bring all the merits
This virtue dedicates merit to those beings that I have harmed. Try doing what I say, when you die, you die, don't be too afraid of death. Everyone will die, don't be afraid of death, put life and death aside like me. Do you think I'm afraid of death? Not only am I not afraid of death, but I also hope to die soon, oh my, how good, saying death is death, no suffering, how wonderful.
What are the results? There are no more illnesses, no more diabetes, high blood pressure of 150-190, I'm still talking here, and my head is not dizzy at all. It is because you forget yourself, look down on yourself, and value sentient beings, I hope sentient beings are free from suffering and are happy.
"Like Venerable Master Hsuan Hua, he wishes the suffering of all living beings in this world to be endured by him alone, and he gives his blessings to everyone. After he said these words, he couldn't eat anything we could eat, like apples, tangerines, bananas, he couldn't eat. Finally, a few days before he passed away, he was constipated and couldn't defecate. Your attendant told me, I told my daughter, my daughter was so scared, she told me: "Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva said to tell the master, take a few slices of bread, cut bananas into thin slices, put them on the bread, then add a little honey, eat these things and you will be fine." I immediately told my master, he said: “Ah, Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara told me to eat? So let's eat." A slice of bread was brought, the master finished eating and said: "For more than four years now, I don't know what the taste of fruit is." It's the truth. Afterwards, I returned home and never ate fruit again. Every time I see fruit, I remember my master's words, as if he were by my side. Lord Hsuan Hua was like that, not eating fruit for four years, because he made vows like that. His wishes caused him to get this disease and not eat
can eat fruit, cannot eat vegetables, can only eat purslane, a type of vegetable with green leaves and pink stems. I came to America from China to bring some for him, then discovered that there was this vegetable in the garden of the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas. Master eats this vegetable every day. Since making vows, he can't eat anything we can eat.
Now I know that there are temples where the monk's lucky money envelope combined with his salary gives him more than ten thousand dong each month, and some people send home ten thousand dong every month. What are you leaving the home life for? Because of money? Leaving the home life liberation is to liberate your karma, do you know? Do you think that leaving the home life and competing for the position of abbot and monk can lead to successful practice? It's not certain, maybe the staff can go to hell, and the person who sweeps the toilet and yard can successfully cultivate out of the Three Realms, it's also very possible. Don't fight, don't be greedy, don't seek, don't be selfish, don't seek personal gain, don't lie, those are the six great principles of Venerable Master Hsuan Hua. Venerable Master Hsuan Hua would rather die of cold than beg, would rather die of hunger than beg for food, would rather die poor than beg for mercy. Unchangeable depending on fate, unchanging depending on fate, upholding our three great principles, sacrificing oneself for the Buddha's sake, righteous life for the monk's sake, creating fate for the sake of the body, that is wisdom, wisdom is the matter. When dealing with anything, you must clearly understand the morality, you cannot act indiscriminately, you cannot help but keep your precepts, that is, reason, then reason. You must clearly understand morality, don't do bad things, that's for every practitioner. The Buddha said so to every practitioner."
Many boys and girls, many people are cultivating, all are cutting off desire and love. A man in Shenzhen, after listening to my lecture, said to me: Teacher Duong, after listening to your lecture, my wife and I are no longer married. Sometimes it's so sad, unbearable, oh my, just
I want to hug you and comfort you a bit." From then until now, there is no longer any desire. Do you know what Buddha preached in "Four strains of pure repentance"? Is that pleasure really like that? Why do I preach about Luong Hoang Sam? What is Luong Hoang Sam? That is the repentance essay written by Master Chi Cong for Emperor Wu of Liang. Many high-ranking monks wrote together, initially there were thirty volumes, but it was too long so it was later shortened. The story of Emperor Wu of Liang, does everyone know? Emperor Wu of Liang's queen did not respect the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Sangha) so she added meat to the monks' food. However, there was a monk who knew in advance that the queen would add meat to their food tomorrow, so they cooked it themselves first. Every day, they only eat one meal and cannot help but eat. When Queen Hy Thi brought food and saw the monks eating, she giggled and thought: "Look, I put meat in their food, but they still like to eat meat." In fact, monks don't eat, they just put meaty food in front of them, but they can't throw it away because if they throw it away they will be beheaded. Instead, they hid meaty food in their sleeves, then ate the food they brought with them. After the swap, they all eat their own food. The food that Queen Hy Thi cooked was taken out and thrown away. Therefore, Queen Hy Thi's karma is very great. She had a very hot temper, often scolding the maids and eunuchs, so even though she was young, around thirty years old, she became seriously ill and passed away.
Emperor Wu of Liang loved her very much. After her death, Emperor Luong Vu did not eat or sleep for many days. One night, when he couldn't sleep in the palace, he decided to go for a walk. While going out, in the quiet night, he suddenly heard movement in the palace. Looking up, he saw a large python wrapped around the pole and sticking its tongue out at him. He asked in panic: "How did you get into the inner palace? What did you come here for? Quickly leave here!". The python replied:
"Your Majesty, don't be afraid, I am your queen, Hy Thi. Because when I was alive I created a lot of bad karma, so after I died I was cast as a python. Later I will have to go to hell, only Your Majesty can save me. I hope your majesty can save me, don't let me go to hell. Right now I'm very miserable, making such a big python, I have no place to live, I can only live in a mountain cave, I have no food, I can only sneak out at night to catch pigs and sheep to eat. I'm so miserable, Your Majesty, please save me, for the sake of our relationship as husband and wife." Having finished speaking, the python disappeared.
Emperor Wu of Liang couldn't sleep all night. The next morning, he invited meditation master Chi Cong to come and tell the story. Zen master Chi Cong advised him to write a repentance essay. After he finished writing, Zen Master Chi Cong and five hundred monks edited it, with a total of thirty volumes. The repentance essay was completed at Gu Keming Temple in Nanjing. After Emperor Wu of Liang held a dharma conference, that night, he heard movement outside again. Could it be that the python had returned? He was scared but still went out to see. However, there was no python, but a fairy appeared in the sky bowing to him. He saw the beautiful nymph and asked: "Who are you?". The fairy replied: "Your Majesty, I am your queen, Hy Thi. Thanks to your Majesty, I escaped the life of a python and was born in heaven. Thank you, Your Majesty...". Having finished speaking, the fairy left. Therefore, this set of Luong Hoang Sam is extremely effective, from that time it has been passed down to this day.
Initially, I didn't know anything about Luong Hoang Sam. I have only read a few books by Venerable Master Hsuan Hua. I came to America, in Los Angeles to welcome Buddhists. The first floor has a lot of people paying homage to the Buddha, I don't know what they are doing. When I arrived, they had already begun, and my daughter and I were invited upstairs to greet the arrivals. People came from all over
around the world, they came to see their master. Each time ten people go upstairs, after talking to me they go downstairs, then another group comes up. I just keep doing it. When I heard them chanting, I thought it was so beautiful, I had never heard it before. I asked the presiding Dharma Master: “What are they doing?”. He replied: "They are paying homage to Luong Hoang Sam." Or so, men are on the right, women are on the left. One moment they knelt down, another moment they bowed, and then they chanted again.
I asked: “Can I welcome others in the afternoon? Can I bow with them in the morning? The magician agreed. So I stood behind, took a music stand, and a cushion to kneel and bow. My daughter was also there. I asked: "I don't know what to do now?". The magician replied: “Study, study and you will know. People chant, you chant, people bow, you bow, people bow, you bow."
I read the content of the sutra saying that people who are angry only think about their own joy and comfort, without thinking that others also need joy and comfort. Everyone needs health, but other people also need health. People who are often angry hinder others from practicing, hinder the health of others, and bring them this or that disaster. I have never thought about these things before, because I am a very hot-tempered person.
When reading this paragraph, I suddenly thought about my wife. She is a good wife and a good mother, but our personalities do not match. God arranged it this way, so that you have the opportunity to practice, there will definitely be an unsuitable person by your side. Our personalities don't match. I am a hasty person, and she is a slow person. To put it in an exaggerated way, she washed a handkerchief that could take up to half an hour to wash, "whirring, rustling", which actually had nothing to do with it.
to me, but hearing that made my heart burn, "You take so long to wash a handkerchief..." and got angry with her. Also, she doesn't eat meat, but I forced her to eat it, and as a result, she ate it and vomited it. This happens often. I have never scolded anyone, nor have I ever scolded or hit her.
But I am a person with a very hot temper. I never thought that other people also needed to be happy and comfortable. Who doesn't want to stay away from anger and sadness? Whenever I get angry with others, maybe I'm too tactful. Even if other people have a reason, they can't talk back. They can't argue back because their tongue is not flexible. Nowadays, people call it bullying. But I never thought I was bullying others, I just thought I was reasonable. I always thought other people were really bad, and until now, I still haven't changed.
When I heard that sutra, I immediately thought of something. One day, my wife said there was a hard lump in her stomach. When I touched and felt the hardness inside, I immediately knew that it was because I was angry, causing her anger and repression inside, eventually leading to that lump. I knew clearly that it was because of me, but at that time I still didn't know how to change, didn't know that I was wrong. I still think it was right for me to get angry, who told her to wash a towel so slowly? When I read that part of Luong Hoang Sam, I immediately remembered that lump, and realized that I had caused it to my wife. At that time, the mind of repentance suddenly arose.
What is repentance? It is not the mouth that says: “Oh, I don't understand Buddha's teachings, I was wrong when I ate meat, from now on I won't eat anymore,” that is not repentance. True repentance must be like a mountain collapsing. Before, I thought scolding
It's right to curse and beat others, because they didn't listen and it's all their fault. But now I realize, oh my gosh, I'm the one in the wrong, it turns out other people are helping me, perfecting me, why am I acting like such a fool? When I read that paragraph and thought about the lump, I realized how many times I got angry at others without thinking like that. At that moment, tears welled up in my eyes, I didn't know how much they flowed. Dharma Master Hoang Nguyen brought a large stack of tissues to wipe my tears and nose. At that moment, I realized my tears were flowing like a river with a broken dike, rushing out. During Luong Hoang Sam, we recite the sutras, kneel, and then bow.
I realized how wonderful Luong Hoang Sam is. Unfortunately I was only able to prostrate one morning. After my master passed away, I returned to China and performed the twelve rituals myself at home. I like to chant and bow at the same time.
Why did I add the words "Man talk"? Because my qualifications are not high, I only have a brief understanding of Luong Hoang Sam. Why did I write Mantra about Luong Hoang Sam? Because Liang Huang Sam from the time of Emperor Wu of Liang has been passed down to this day, many people have bowed to Liang Huang Sam, but if you ask them what it means, they don't know. How can this be acceptable? If you have bowed, you must clearly understand the inner principles.
Therefore, in Buddhism there is a saying: "Penetrate the scriptures, wisdom is like the sea". We say that the meditation master Chi Cong is the reincarnation of Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, we respect him, call him the reincarnation of Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, but he himself absolutely never calls himself the reincarnation of Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva. Hope everyone can read the book Mantra about Luong Hoang Sam.
In the book Romance about Luong Hoang Sam, there is a story as follows: There was an immortal who knew how to chant sutras, cultivate in mountains and recite sutras in caves. People know he is a religious person. One time, it rained heavily for seven days, and no one brought him food. That fairy chanting sutras was so hungry that he lay on the ground. At this time, a group of rabbits appeared from the bushes. Before that, they came every day to listen to him chanting sutras. Don't think that rabbits can't listen to sutras. You see, in the circus, from elephants to small dogs and small monkeys, everyone can understand what people say. Even flowers and trees can be understood when we talk.
Among the five hundred rabbits, there is one king rabbit, a female rabbit. The rabbit king said to his son: “Son, we listen to the sutras every day, but this sage chanting sutras has gone seven days without food. If he doesn't have food, he will starve to death, and if he dies, we will no longer be able to listen to the Buddha's sutras. I pray for heaven's fire to burn my body, roast it, then tell the other rabbits to take my body out and feed it to the chanting sutras fairy. I will use my body to make offerings to this immortal chanting sutras, so I can reach a higher realm. When I am reborn as a human, I will strive to practice and must escape the Three Realms.”
Little bunny said: "Mom, I also want to make offerings for the immortal with you." They then told this idea to five hundred other rabbits. At this moment, a bolt of lightning struck and fire broke out. King Rabbit saw that the wood was still wet and cold and difficult to ignite, so he jumped into the fire. The fire immediately burned brightly, extremely warm. Thanks to the merit of dedicating himself, the rabbit king's consciousness ascended to the Tushita heaven. The little rabbit also jumped into the fire afterwards.
Many trees on the mountain were deeply moved by the noble behavior of the rabbit king and the little rabbit. The tree spirit transformed into a human form, entered the cave, raised the chanting sutras fairy from the ground and said: "Sir chanting sutras, the rabbits have come to invite you for a meal." The fairy looked out of the cave and saw a bonfire, in which two rabbits had been roasted. The mother rabbit and her baby rabbits listened to him chanting sutras every day. Now that he could no longer chant sutras, they burned themselves so that he could eat his fill and continue chanting sutras. There are many other rabbits who still want to listen to the sutra. I am the tree god, we all love to hear him chant. Sutras can educate us and help us escape from the ocean of suffering. Please go out to eat."
The fairy chanting sutras did not believe, thinking that this could not happen, why would anyone burn themselves for others to eat? The tree spirit helped him stand up. When he saw two grilled rabbits on the ground, he was moved to tears and said: "Oh, I have also eaten sentient beings before. Those sentient beings, like me, can also understand Buddha's teachings. I'm so ashamed. In the future, if I become Buddha, I will definitely educate everyone and never eat living beings again. They died because of me, how could I be so cruel as to eat them? We must repay their life debt." Having finished speaking, from then on he began a hunger strike, not eating or drinking anything anymore.
Do you know who that fairy chanting sutras is? He is Maitreya Bodhisattva. Who is the mother rabbit? It is the predecessor of Shakyamuni Buddha. And who is the bunny? It is the predecessor of Rahu La. Who is the tree god? It is the predecessor of Maudgalyayana. This is something I looked up from the Tripitaka, and when I read this passage, I shed tears.
Nowadays, we often differentiate, thinking that this is Maitreya Bodhisattva, this is Buddha, Buddha is the most precious, this is Earth.
Bodhisattva, the ruler of hell, this is Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, with a thousand hands and a thousand eyes. This way of speaking is not correct. All Buddhas and Bodhisattva have the same dharmakaya, they all have the same power, they all have the same six types of supernatural powers. Only we, sentient beings in the six paths, have the distinction.
If we can repentance each bad thing we have done, such as eating meat, killing, greed, the sins created by the six senses (eyes, ears, nose, tongue, body, mind), then the repentance will be like a mountain collapsing. So what is a mountain collapsing? I will tell a true story that happened in Tianjin, published in the newspaper.
There is a son who likes to play video games, often goes outside, and doesn't come home all night. From this incident, look back at yourself, unfilial, adulterous, hot-tempered! Are these not deep-rooted diseases within ourselves? The level of stubbornness is even greater than that girl! So do all the questions still need to be asked?! Only sincere repentance, absolutely no repeat offense!
